ex.en: the voters' identification of the Democrats with high taxes
ex.cn: 选民把民主党和高税收画上等号

senses.def: a row of people, including one person who is suspected of a crime, who are shown to a witness to see if he or she can recognize the criminal
senses.chn: 辨认行列，列队认人（把嫌疑犯同其他人排在一起，让目击者辨认）

senses.def: a series of characters used to refer to a program or set of data within a program
senses.chn: 标识符（可用以进入程序或其中的数据集）

senses.def: to recognize sb/sth and be able to say who or what they are

ex.en: The bodies were identified as those of two suspected drug dealers.
ex.cn: 那两具尸体被辨认出原是两名贩毒嫌疑犯。

ex.en: She was able to identify her attacker.
ex.cn: 她认出了袭击她的人。

ex.en: Passengers were asked to identify their own suitcases before they were put on the plane.
ex.cn: 乘客被要求先确认自己的旅行箱再送上飞机。

ex.en: Many of those arrested refused to identify themselves (= would not say who they were).
ex.cn: 很多被逮捕的人拒不透露身份。

ex.en: First of all we must identify the problem areas.
ex.cn: 首先我们必须找出问题所在。

senses.def: to find or discover sb/sth

ex.en: Scientists have identified a link between diet and cancer.
ex.cn: 科学家发现了饮食与癌症之间的关联。

ex.en: As yet they have not identified a buyer for the company.
ex.cn: 迄今为止他们还没有为公司找到买主。

ex.en: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.
ex.cn: 他们正试图弄清现行制度的弊端所在。

senses.def: to make it possible to recognize who or what sb/sth is

ex.en: In many cases, the clothes people wear identify them as belonging to a particular social class.
ex.cn: 很多情况下，人们的穿着显示出他们的社会阶层。

senses.def: to feel that you can understand and share the feelings of sb else
senses.chn: 与某人产生共鸣；谅解；同情

ex.en: I didn't enjoy the book because I couldn't identify with any of the main characters.
ex.cn: 我不喜欢这本书，因为我无法与其中的任何主要角色产生共鸣。

senses.def: to consider sb to be sth

ex.en: He was not the 'tough guy' the public identified him with.
ex.cn: 他并不是公众所认定的那种硬汉。

senses.def: to consider sth to be the same as sth else

ex.en: You should not identify wealth with happiness.
ex.cn: 你不应该认为财富就等于幸福。

senses.def: to support sb/sth; to be closely connected with sb/sth

ex.en: The Church became increasingly identified with opposition to the regime.
ex.cn: 教会日益和反对政权的势力走到一起。

example.en: The bodies were identified as those of two suspected drug dealers.
example.cn: 那两具尸体被辨认出原是两名贩毒嫌疑犯。

example.en: She was able to identify her attacker.
example.cn: 她认出了袭击她的人。

example.en: Scientists have identified a link between diet and cancer.
example.cn: 科学家发现了饮食与癌症之间的关联。

example.en: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.
example.cn: 他们正试图弄清现行制度的弊端所在。

senses.def: to consider sb to be sth

ex.en: He was not the 'tough guy' the public identified him with.
ex.cn: 他并不是公众所认定的那种硬汉。

senses.def: to consider sth to be the same as sth else

ex.en: You should not identify wealth with happiness.
ex.cn: 你不应该认为财富就等于幸福。

senses.def: to feel that you can understand and share the feelings of sb else
senses.chn: 与某人产生共鸣；谅解；同情

ex.en: I didn't enjoy the book because I couldn't identify with any of the main characters.
ex.cn: 我不喜欢这本书，因为我无法与其中的任何主要角色产生共鸣。

senses.def: who or what sb/sth is

ex.en: The police are trying to discover the identity of the killer.
ex.cn: 警方正努力调查杀人凶手的身份。

ex.en: Their identities were kept secret.
ex.cn: 他们的身份保密。

ex.en: She is innocent; it was a case of mistaken identity.
ex.cn: 她是无辜的；那是身份判断错误。

ex.en: Do you have any proof of identity?
ex.cn: 你有身份证明吗？

ex.en: The thief used a false identity.
ex.cn: 窃贼使用的是假身份。

ex.en: She went through an identity crisis in her teens (= was not sure of who she was or of her place in society).
ex.cn: 她在十多岁时经历了一次身份危机。

senses.def: the characteristics, feelings or beliefs that distinguish people from others
senses.chn: 特征；特有的感觉（或信仰）

ex.en: a sense of national/cultural/personal/group identity
ex.cn: 民族／文化／个人／群体特性的认同感

ex.en: a plan to strengthen the corporate identity of the company
ex.cn: 加强公司的企业形象的计划

senses.def: the state or feeling of being very similar to and able to understand sb/sth

ex.en: an identity of interests
ex.cn: 利益一致

ex.en: There's a close identity between fans and their team.
ex.cn: 球迷和他们的球队之间有密切的同一性。

senses.def: a card with a person's name, date of birth, photograph, etc. on it that proves who they are
using sb else's name and personal information in order to obtain credit cards and other goods or to take money out of the person's bank accounts
senses.chn: 身份盗窃（利用别人的名字、个人信息等获得信用卡、其他物品或从别人的账户中提取现金等）

senses.def: a symbol that is used in a writing system, for example Chinese, to represent the idea of a thing, rather than the sounds of a word
a sign or a symbol for sth
a person whose actions are influenced by belief in a set of principles (= by an ideology)
a set of ideas that an economic or political system is based on

ex.en: Marxist/capitalist ideology
ex.cn: 马克思主义／资本主义思想体系

senses.def: a set of beliefs, especially one held by a particular group, that influences the way people behave

ex.en: the ideology of gender roles
ex.cn: 性别角色的观念形态

ex.en: alternative ideologies
ex.cn: 非传统的意识形态

senses.def: the middle day of the month in the ancient Roman system, from which other days were calculated
senses.chn: 月中日（古罗马历每月居中的一天）

ex.en: the ides of March
ex.cn: 3 月 15 日

senses.def: very stupid behaviour; the state of being very stupid
a very stupid act, remark, etc.

ex.en: the idiocies of bureaucracy
ex.cn: 官僚体系所做的蠢事

senses.def: the way that a particular person uses language
senses.chn: 个人语型；个人言语方式

senses.def: a group of words whose meaning is different from the meanings of the individual words

ex.en: 'Let the cat out of the bag' is an idiom meaning to tell a secret by mistake.
ex.cn: “让猫从袋子里跑出来” 是惯用语，意思是无意中泄露秘密。

ex.en: Do not write more than 200 words.
ex.cn: 写的东西不要超过 200 字。

ex.en: He uses a lot of long words.
ex.cn: 他使用了很多长词。

ex.en: technical/legal/scientific terms
ex.cn: 专门／法律／科学用语

ex.en: 'Old man' is a slang term for 'father'. *
ex.cn: old man 为俚语，指父亲。

ex.en: Who coined the phrase 'desktop publishing'?
ex.cn: 谁创造了 desktop publishing（桌面出版）这个词组？

senses.def: the kind of language and grammar used by particular people at a particular time or place
senses.chn: （某时期或某地区的人的）语言和语法

senses.def: the style of writing, music, art, etc. that is typical of a particular person, group, period or place
senses.chn: （写作、音乐、艺术等的）典型风格

ex.en: the classical/contemporary/popular idiom
ex.cn: 古典／当代／通俗风格

senses.def: containing expressions that are natural to a native speaker of a language
senses.chn: 表达方式地道的；符合（某一）语言习惯的

ex.en: She speaks fluent and idiomatic English.
ex.cn: 她讲一口流利地道的英语。

senses.def: containing an idiom

ex.en: an idiomatic expression
ex.cn: 惯用语

senses.def: a person's particular way of behaving, thinking, etc., especially when it is unusual; an unusual feature

ex.en: The car has its little idiosyncrasies.
ex.cn: 这辆车有它的一些小小脾气。

senses.def: a very stupid person

ex.en: When I lost my passport, I felt such an idiot.
ex.cn: 我丢了护照时觉得自己像个大傻瓜。

ex.en: Not that switch, you idiot!
ex.cn: 不是那个开关，你这个蠢货！

senses.def: a person with very low intelligence who cannot think or behave normally
very stupid

ex.en: an idiotic question
ex.cn: 很愚蠢的问题

ex.en: Don't be so idiotic!
ex.cn: 别这么傻了！

senses.def: a person who has severe learning difficulties, but who has an unusually high level of ability in a particular skill, for example in art or music, or in remembering things
senses.chn: 弱能特才，低能特才（有严重的学习障碍，但在艺术、音乐或记忆等方面有超常能力）

senses.def: (especially in text messages, emails, etc.) I don't know
senses.chn: 我不知道（全写为 I don't know，尤用于短信、电邮等）

ex.en: IDK what to do about it.
ex.cn: 我不知道这事该怎么办。

senses.def: not working hard

ex.en: an idle student
ex.cn: 懒散的学生

senses.def: not in use

ex.en: to lie/stand/remain idle
ex.cn: 闲置着

senses.def: without work

ex.en: Over ten per cent of the workforce is now idle.
ex.cn: 现在有超过百分之十的劳动力闲置。

senses.def: with no particular purpose or effect; useless
senses.chn: 漫无目的的；无效的；无用的

ex.en: idle chatter/curiosity
ex.cn: 无聊的唠叨／好奇

ex.en: It was just an idle threat (= not serious).
ex.cn: 那只不过是吓唬吓唬而已。

ex.en: It is idle to pretend that their marriage is a success.
ex.cn: 佯装他们的婚姻有多美满是无意义的。

senses.def: not spent doing work or sth particular

ex.en: In idle moments, he carved wooden figures.
ex.cn: 他空闲时就刻木雕。

senses.def: people who do not have enough to do often start to do wrong

ex.en: She blamed the crimes on the local jobless teenagers. 'The devil makes work for idle hands,' she would say.
ex.cn: 她认为那些违法活动是当地的无业青少年所为，总是说：“人一闲，惹麻烦。”

senses.def: to spend time doing nothing important

ex.en: They idled the days away, talking and watching television.
ex.cn: 他们天天在闲聊和看电视中消磨时光。

ex.en: They idled along by the river (= walked slowly and with no particular purpose).
ex.cn: 他们沿着河边闲逛。

senses.def: to run slowly while the vehicle is not moving

ex.en: She left the car idling at the roadside.
ex.cn: 她把汽车挂空挡停在路边。

senses.def: to close a factory, etc. or stop providing work for the workers, especially temporarily
senses.chn: （尤指暂时地）关闭工厂，使（工人）闲着

ex.en: The strikes have idled nearly 4 000 workers.
ex.cn: 罢工使近 4 000 名工人闲着没事干。

example.en: They idled the days away, talking and watching television.
example.cn: 他们天天在闲聊和看电视中消磨时光。

example.en: They idled along by the river (= walked slowly and with no particular purpose).
example.cn: 他们沿着河边闲逛。

senses.def: a person who is lazy and does not work
an Indian rice cake cooked using steam
without any particular reason, purpose or effort; doing nothing
senses.chn: 毫无目的地；漫不经心地；闲散地

ex.en: She sat in the sun, idly sipping a cool drink.
ex.cn: 她坐在阳光下懒洋洋地抿着冷饮。

ex.en: He wondered idly what would happen.
ex.cn: 他漫不经心地幻想着会发生什么事。

ex.en: We can't stand idly by (= do nothing) and let people starve.
ex.cn: 我们不能袖手旁观，任由人们挨饿。

senses.def: a person or thing that is loved and admired very much
senses.chn: 受到热爱和崇拜的人（或物）；偶像

ex.en: a pop/football/teen, etc. idol
ex.cn: 流行音乐偶像、足球明星、青少年的偶像等

ex.en: the idol of countless teenagers
ex.cn: 无数青少年崇拜的偶像

ex.en: a fallen idol (= sb who is no longer popular)
ex.cn: 陨落的明星

senses.def: a statue that is worshipped as a god
the practice of worshipping statues as gods
too much love or admiration for sb/sth

ex.en: football fans whose support for their team borders on idolatry
ex.cn: 对球队几乎到了盲目崇拜地步的足球迷

senses.def: to admire or love sb very much

ex.en: a pop star idolized by millions of fans
ex.cn: 受数百万歌迷崇拜的流行音乐歌星

ex.en: They idolize their kids.
ex.cn: 他们溺爱自己的孩子。

i don't mind if i do.lemma: i don't mind if i do

senses.def: used to say politely that you would like sth you have been offered
senses.chn: （礼貌地表示愿意接受）好的，可以

ex.en: 'Cup of tea, Brian?' 'I don't mind if I do.'
ex.cn: “喝杯茶吧，布赖恩？” “好的。”

senses.def: used to say very strongly that you do not agree with sth, or that sth is not possible
senses.chn: 我想并非如此；我不这样认为；根本不可能

ex.en: Me? Fail? I don't think so.
ex.cn: 我？失败？我可不这样认为。

senses.def: a happy and peaceful place, event or experience, especially one connected with the countryside
senses.chn: （尤指乡下的）愉快恬静的地方（或事情、经历）

senses.def: a short poem or other piece of writing that describes a peaceful and happy scene
senses.chn: 描述恬静愉快情景的短诗（或短文）；田园诗

senses.def: peaceful and beautiful; perfect, without problems
senses.chn: 平和美丽的；完美无瑕的

ex.en: a house set in idyllic surroundings
ex.cn: 在田园风光的环境中的房子

ex.en: to lead an idyllic existence
ex.cn: 过着诗情画意的生活

ex.en: The cottage sounds idyllic.
ex.cn: 小屋看来恬静宜人。

senses.def: improvised explosive device (a bomb made and used by people who are not members of the military forces of a country)

the abbreviation for 'International English Language Testing System' (a test that measures a person's ability to speak and write English at the level that is necessary to go to university in the UK, Ireland, Australia, Canada, South Africa and New Zealand)
senses.chn: 国际英语测试系统考试，雅思考试（全写为 International English Language Testing System，英国、爱尔兰、澳大利亚、加拿大、南非和新西兰大学入学水平的英语应用能力考试）

senses.def: used to say that one thing can, will or might happen or be true, depending on another thing happening or being true

ex.en: If you see him, give him this note.
ex.cn: 你要是见到他，就把这个便条给他。

ex.en: I'll only stay if you offer me more money.
ex.cn: 你给我更多的钱我才会留下。

ex.en: If necessary I can come at once.
ex.cn: 如果有必要，我可以马上来。

ex.en: You can stay for the weekend if you like.
ex.cn: 你如果愿意就留在这里过周末吧。

ex.en: If anyone calls, tell them I'm not at home.
ex.cn: 要是有人打电话来，就说我不在家。

ex.en: If he improved his IT skills, he'd (= he would) easily get a job.
ex.cn: 他如果提高了自己的信息技术技能，就会容易找到工作。

senses.def: when; whenever; every time

ex.en: If metal gets hot it expands.
ex.cn: 金属受热就膨胀。

ex.en: She glares at me if I go near her desk.
ex.cn: 我一走近她的办公桌，她就对我瞪眼。

senses.def: used with will or would to ask sb politely to do sth
senses.chn: （与 will 或 would 连用，表示客气地请求）

ex.en: If you will sit down for a few moments, I'll tell the manager you're here.
ex.cn: 请稍坐，我这就告诉经理说您来了。

ex.en: If you would care to leave your name, we'll contact you as soon as possible.
ex.cn: 麻烦您留下姓名，我们会尽快与您联系的。

senses.def: used after ask, know, find out, wonder, etc. to introduce one of two or more possibilities
senses.chn: （用于 ask、know、find out、wonder 等之后，引出两个或以上的可能性之一）是否

ex.en: Do you know if he's married?
ex.cn: 你知道他是否结婚了？

ex.en: I wonder if I should wear a coat or not.
ex.cn: 我不知道该不该穿外套。

ex.en: He couldn't tell if she was laughing or crying.
ex.cn: 他弄不清楚她是在笑还是在哭。

ex.en: Listen to the tune and see if you can remember the words.
ex.cn: 听听曲调，看你能否记起歌词。

ex.en: She asked if/whether I wanted a drink.
ex.cn: 她问我要不要喝点什么。

ex.en: We didn't know if/whether we should write or phone.
ex.cn: 我们不知道是写信好还是打电话好。

senses.def: used after verbs or adjectives expressing feelings
senses.chn: （用于表示情感的动词或形容词之后）

ex.en: I am sorry if I disturbed you.
ex.cn: 很抱歉，打搅您了。

ex.en: I'd be grateful if you would keep it a secret.
ex.cn: 你如果能对此保密，我将不胜感激。

ex.en: Do you mind if I turn the TV off?
ex.cn: 我关上电视可以吗？

senses.def: used to admit that sth is possible, but to say that it is not very important
senses.chn: （承认某事可能，但不很重要）即使，虽然

ex.en: If she has any weakness, it is her Italian.
ex.cn: 如果要说她有什么缺点，那就是她的意大利语不大行。

ex.en: So what if he was late. Who cares?
ex.cn: 他就是迟到了又怎么样。谁在乎？

senses.def: used before an adjective to introduce a contrast
senses.chn: （置于形容词之前，引出对比）虽然，尽管

ex.en: He's a good driver, if a little over-confident.
ex.cn: 他是个好司机，虽然有点过于自信。

ex.en: We'll only do it once— if at all.
ex.cn: 我们就是干也只会干一次。

senses.def: used to ask sb to listen to your opinion

ex.en: If you ask me, she's too scared to do it.
ex.cn: 依我看，她被吓得不敢做了。

ex.en: If you think about it, those children must be at school by now.
ex.cn: 想想吧，那些孩子现在一定在学校了。

ex.en: If you remember, Mary was always fond of animals.
ex.cn: 记得吧，玛丽总是喜欢动物。

senses.def: used before could, may or might to suggest sth or to interrupt sb politely
senses.chn: （置于 could、may 或 might 之前，提出建议或客气地打断别人的话）

ex.en: If I may make a suggestion, perhaps we could begin a little earlier next week.
ex.cn: 我来提个建议吧，或许我们下个星期可以早一点开始。

senses.def: used to say sth about an event that may or may not happen
senses.chn: （谈及可能发生或不发生的事时说）

ex.en: If and when we ever meet again I hope he remembers what I did for him.
ex.cn: 倘若我们再次见面，我希望他还记得我为他做的事。

senses.def: used to express an opinion about sth, or after a negative statement to suggest that the opposite is true
senses.chn: （表达看法，或用在否定句之后表示反面意见才对）

ex.en: I'd say he was more like his father, if anything.
ex.cn: 依我看，如果一定要说他像谁的话，他比较像他的父亲。

ex.en: She's not thin—if anything she's on the plump side.
ex.cn: 她并不瘦，其实她还有点胖呢。

senses.def: used to give sb advice

ex.en: If I were you I'd start looking for another job.
ex.cn: 我要是你，就会去另找工作了。

senses.def: used to introduce a different suggestion, after a sentence with if
senses.chn: （用在 if 引导的句子之后）不然，要不

ex.en: I'll go if you're going. If not (= if you are not) I'd rather stay at home.
ex.cn: 你去我就去。不然的话，我宁愿待在家里。

senses.def: used after a yes/no question to say what will or should happen if the answer is 'no'
senses.chn: （用于 yes／no 疑问句之后，表示如果答案是 no，将会或应该发生什么）

ex.en: Are you ready? If not, I'm going without you.
ex.cn: 你准备好了吗？否则我就自己去了。

ex.en: Do you want that cake? If not, I'll have it.
ex.cn: 你要那块蛋糕吗？不然我就要了。

senses.def: used to suggest that sth may be even larger, more important, etc. than was first stated

ex.en: They cost thousands if not millions of pounds to build.
ex.cn: 建设要耗费数千英镑，甚至可能是数百万英镑。

senses.def: used to say that you wish sth was true or that sth had happened

ex.en: If only I were rich.
ex.cn: 但愿我很富有。

ex.en: If only I knew her name.
ex.cn: 我要是知道她的名字就好了。

ex.en: If only he'd remembered to send that letter.
ex.cn: 要是他没忘记发那封信就好了。

ex.en: If only I had gone by taxi.
ex.cn: 我要是乘出租车去就好了。

senses.def: used to say that sth that is happening is surprising
senses.chn: （表示所发生的事情令人惊讶）

ex.en: I'm surprised they've invited me to their wedding—it's not as if I know them well.
ex.cn: 我很惊讶他们居然请我参加他们的婚礼，我跟他们似乎并不熟。

senses.def: used to state the only situation in which sth can happen

ex.en: Only if a teacher has given permission is a student allowed to leave the room.
ex.cn: 学生只有得到老师的许可才能离开教室。

ex.en: Only if the red light comes on is there any danger to employees.
ex.cn: 只有红灯闪亮时才有危及职工的险情。

senses.def: a situation that is not certain

ex.en: If he wins—and it's a big if —he'll be the first Englishman to win for fifty years.

ex.cn: 她的绘画风格为其他画家所模仿。

ex.en: Art imitates Nature.
ex.cn: 艺术是对大自然的仿制。

ex.en: Teachers provide a model for children to imitate.
ex.cn: 教师是孩子仿效的典范。

ex.en: No computer can imitate the complex functions of the human brain.
ex.cn: 任何计算机都无法模拟人脑的复杂功能。

senses.def: to copy the way a person speaks or behaves, in order to amuse people
senses.chn: 模仿（某人的讲话、举止）；作滑稽模仿

ex.en: She knew that the girls used to imitate her and laugh at her behind her back.
ex.cn: 她知道那些女孩子过去常在背地里模仿她、嘲笑她。

senses.def: a copy of sth, especially sth expensive

ex.en: a poor/cheap imitation of the real thing
ex.cn: 低劣的仿制品

ex.en: This latest production is a pale imitation of the original (= it is not nearly as good).
ex.cn: 最新推出的制作远不如它所依据的原著精彩。

ex.en: imitation leather/pearls
ex.cn: 人造革；假珍珠

ex.en: artificial flowers
ex.cn: 假花

ex.en: artificial light
ex.cn: 人造光

ex.en: synthetic drugs
ex.cn: 合成药物

senses.def: the act of copying sb/sth

ex.en: A child learns to talk by imitation.
ex.cn: 小孩子通过模仿学会说话。

ex.en: Many corporate methods have been adopted by American managers in imitation of Japanese practice.
ex.cn: 美国的管理人员采用了很多取法日本的公司经营之道。

senses.def: an act of copying the way sb talks and behaves, especially to make people laugh
senses.chn: 模仿（某人）的言谈举止；（尤指）滑稽模仿

ex.en: He does an imitation of Barack Obama.
ex.cn: 他滑稽地模仿巴拉克 · 奥巴马。

senses.def: that copies sb/sth

ex.en: movies that encourage imitative crime
ex.cn: 助长模拟犯罪行为的电影

ex.en: His work has been criticized for being imitative and shallow.
ex.cn: 他的作品被批抄袭而且肤浅。

senses.def: a person or thing that copies sb/sth else
senses.chn: 模仿者；模拟…的人（或事物）

ex.en: The band's success has inspired hundreds of would-be imitators.
ex.cn: 乐队的成功激励了数以百计未来的追随者。

senses.def: extremely clean and tidy

ex.en: She always looks immaculate.
ex.cn: 她总是打扮得干净利落。

ex.en: an immaculate uniform/room
ex.cn: 整洁的制服／房间

senses.def: containing no mistakes

ex.en: an immaculate performance
ex.cn: 完美的演出

senses.def: present as a natural part of sth; present everywhere
senses.chn: 内在的；固有的；无所不在的

senses.def: not important in a particular situation

ex.en: The cost is immaterial.
ex.cn: 费用并不重要。

ex.en: It is immaterial to me whether he stays or goes.
ex.cn: 他的去留与我无关。

senses.def: not having a physical form

ex.en: an immaterial God
ex.cn: 无形的上帝

example.en: It is immaterial to me whether he stays or goes.
example.cn: 他的去留与我无关。

senses.def: behaving in a way that is not sensible and is typical of people who are much younger
senses.chn: （行为）不成熟的，不够老练的，幼稚的

ex.en: immature behaviour
ex.cn: 不成熟的行为

senses.def: not fully developed or grown

ex.en: immature plants
ex.cn: 未长成的植物

senses.def: too large, great, etc. to be measured
senses.chn: 不可估量的；无限的；无穷的

ex.en: to cause immeasurable harm
ex.cn: 造成不可估量的损害

senses.def: the quality in sth that makes it seem as if it is happening now, close to you, and is therefore important, urgent, etc.
senses.chn: 直接性；即时性；直观性；迫切性

ex.en: the immediacy of threat
ex.cn: 威胁的迫切性

ex.en: Email lacks the immediacy of online chat.
ex.cn: 电子邮件缺乏在线交谈的即时性。

senses.def: lack of delay; speed

ex.en: Our aim is immediacy of response to emergency calls.
ex.cn: 我们的目标是对紧急求救电话立刻作出回应。

senses.def: happening or done without delay

ex.en: an immediate reaction/response
ex.cn: 即时的反应／回应

ex.en: to take immediate action
ex.cn: 立刻采取行动

senses.def: existing now and needing urgent attention

ex.en: Our immediate concern is to help the families of those who died.
ex.cn: 我们的当务之急是帮助那些死者的亲属。

ex.en: The effects of global warming, while not immediate, are potentially catastrophic.
ex.cn: 全球气温上升的后果虽然并非即时发生，但可能潜伏着大灾难。

ex.en: The hospital says she's out of immediate danger.
ex.cn: 医院说她眼下已脱离危险。

senses.def: next to or very close to a particular place or time

ex.en: in the immediate vicinity
ex.cn: 近在咫尺

ex.en: The prospects for the immediate future are good.
ex.cn: 短期内前景乐观。

ex.en: The director is standing on her immediate right.
ex.cn: 主管就挨在她的右边站着。

ex.en: my immediate predecessor in the job (= the person who had the job just before me)
ex.cn: 我的职位的前一任

senses.def: nearest in relationship or rank
senses.chn: （关系或级别）最接近的，直系的，直接的

ex.en: The funeral was attended by her immediate family (= her parents, children, brothers and sisters) only.
ex.cn: 只有她的直系亲属参加了葬礼。

ex.en: He is my immediate superior (= the person directly above me) in the company.
ex.cn: 他在公司里是我的顶头上司。

senses.def: having a direct effect

ex.en: The immediate cause of death is unknown.
ex.cn: 造成死亡的直接原因不明。

senses.def: starting now; starting from…
senses.chn: 立即生效；从…起开始生效

ex.en: The government has cut interest rates with effect from the beginning of next month.
ex.cn: 政府已削减利率，从下月初开始生效。

senses.def: without delay

ex.en: She answered almost immediately.
ex.cn: 她几乎立刻就回答了。

ex.en: The point of my question may not be immediately apparent.
ex.cn: 我的问题的要点可能不是一下子就能看出来的。

senses.def: next to or very close to a particular place or time

ex.en: Turn right immediately after the church.
ex.cn: 一过教堂就向右拐。

ex.en: the years immediately before the war
ex.cn: 战前的最后几年

senses.def: closely and directly

ex.en: Counselling is being given to those most immediately affected by the tragedy.
ex.cn: 目前正在向惨剧的最直接受害者提供辅导服务。

senses.def: as soon as

ex.en: Immediately she'd gone, I remembered her name.
ex.cn: 她刚走开我就想起了她的名字。

senses.def: that has existed for longer than people can remember
senses.chn: 古老的；远古的；无法追忆的

ex.en: an immemorial tradition
ex.cn: 古老的传统

ex.en: My family has lived in this area from time immemorial (= for hundreds of years).
ex.cn: 我的家族在这个地区已经生活了不知有多少年了。

senses.def: extremely large or great

ex.en: There is still an immense amount of work to be done.
ex.cn: 还有非常非常多的工作要做。

ex.en: The benefits are immense.
ex.cn: 效益是极大的。

ex.en: a project of immense importance
ex.cn: 极其重要的工程

senses.def: extremely; very much

ex.en: immensely popular/difficult/grateful
ex.cn: 非常受欢迎／艰难／感激

ex.en: We enjoyed ourselves immensely.
ex.cn: 我们玩得好极了。

senses.def: the large size of sth

ex.en: the immensity of the universe
ex.cn: 宇宙的浩瀚无垠

ex.en: We were overwhelmed by the sheer immensity of the task.
ex.cn: 任务太重，把我们都吓倒了。

senses.def: to put sb/sth into a liquid so that they or it are completely covered
to become or make sb completely involved in sth

ex.en: She immersed herself in her work.
ex.cn: 她埋头工作。

ex.en: Clare and Phil were immersed in conversation in the corner.
ex.cn: 克莱尔和菲尔在角落里深谈。

senses.def: the act of putting sb/sth into a liquid so that they or it are completely covered; the state of being completely covered by a liquid

ex.en: Immersion in cold water resulted in rapid loss of heat.
ex.cn: 浸泡在冷水中导致热量迅速散失。

ex.en: baptism by total immersion (= putting the whole body underwater)
ex.cn: 浸水式洗礼

senses.def: the state of being completely involved in sth

ex.en: his long immersion in politics
ex.cn: 他长期潜心从政

ex.en: a two-week immersion course in French (= in which the student will hear and use only French)
ex.cn: 两周的沉浸式法语课程（学生身处完全的法语环境中）

senses.def: a device that provides hot water for a house by heating water in a tank
used to describe a computer system or image that seems to surround the user
senses.chn: （计算机系统或图像）沉浸式虚拟现实的

ex.en: Immersive games can be used for training and education.
ex.cn: 沉浸式虚拟现实的游戏可用于培训和教育。

senses.def: a person who has come to live permanently in a country that is not their own

ex.en: immigrant communities/families/workers
ex.cn: 侨民团体／家庭／劳工

ex.en: illegal immigrants
ex.cn: 非法移民

senses.def: to come and live permanently in a country after leaving your own country
the process of coming to live permanently in a country that is not your own; the number of people who do this

ex.en: laws restricting immigration into the US
ex.cn: 美国限制外来移民的法律

ex.en: a rise/fall in immigration
ex.cn: 移民人数的增加／减少

ex.en: immigration officers
ex.cn: 移民局官员

senses.def: the place at a port, an airport, etc. where the passports and other documents of people coming into a country are checked

ex.en: to go through immigration
ex.cn: 通过移民局检查

senses.def: likely to happen very soon

ex.en: the imminent threat of invasion
ex.cn: 迫在眉睫的入侵威胁

ex.en: The system is in imminent danger of collapse.
ex.cn: 这个体制面临着崩溃的危险。

ex.en: An announcement about his resignation is imminent.
ex.cn: 马上就要宣布他的辞职。

senses.def: that cannot be mixed together
not moving

ex.en: She stood immobile by the window.
ex.cn: 她一动不动地靠窗站着。

senses.def: unable to move
senses.chn: 不能移动的；不能活动的

ex.en: His illness has left him completely immobile.
ex.cn: 他的病使他完全丧失了活动能力。

senses.def: to prevent sth/sb from moving or from working normally
senses.chn: 使不动；使不能正常运作

ex.en: a device to immobilize the car engine in case of theft
ex.cn: 遇到有人盗车时使汽车引擎发动不了的装置

ex.en: Always immobilize a broken leg immediately.
ex.cn: 腿断了应立即加以固定。

senses.def: a device that is fitted to a car to stop it moving if sb tries to steal it
senses.chn: 汽车防盗器（遇到有人盗车时使汽车开不动的装置）

senses.def: extreme; not reasonable
senses.chn: 极端的；不适度的；不合理的；过度的

ex.en: immoderate drinking
ex.cn: 无节制的饮酒

senses.def: having or showing a very high opinion of yourself and your abilities
not considered to be socially acceptable by most people, especially concerning sexual behaviour
senses.chn: 不正派的；不合礼仪的；猥亵的

ex.en: an immodest dress
ex.cn: 有伤风化的连衣裙

senses.def: to kill sb by burning them
not considered to be good or honest by most people

ex.en: It's immoral to steal.
ex.cn: 偷盗是不道德的。

ex.en: There's nothing immoral about wanting to earn more money.
ex.cn: 想多赚点钱没什么不道德。

senses.def: not following accepted standards of sexual behaviour

ex.en: an immoral act/life/person
ex.cn: 淫荡的举动／生活／人

ex.en: They were charged with living off immoral earnings (= money earned by working as a prostitute ).
ex.cn: 她们被控靠卖淫为生。

senses.def: that lives or lasts for ever

ex.en: The soul is immortal.
ex.cn: 灵魂不灭。

senses.def: famous and likely to be remembered for ever
senses.chn: 流芳百世的；名垂千古的

ex.en: the immortal Goethe
ex.cn: 名垂千古的歌德

ex.en: In the immortal words of Henry Ford, 'If it ain't broke, don't fix it.'
ex.cn: 按照亨利 · 福特的不朽名言：“如果东西没坏掉，就不要去修理它。”

senses.def: a person who is so famous that they will be remembered for ever
senses.chn: 不朽的人物；名垂千古的人物

ex.en: She is one of the Hollywood immortals.
ex.cn: 她是一位千古流芳的好莱坞名人。

senses.def: a god or other being who is believed to live for ever
the state of being immortal

ex.en: belief in the immortality of the soul
ex.cn: 灵魂不灭的信念

ex.en: He is well on his way to showbusiness immortality.
ex.cn: 他很快就会成为娱乐界永世流芳的人物。

senses.def: to prevent sb/sth from being forgotten in the future, especially by mentioning them in literature, making films/movies about them, painting them, etc.
senses.chn: 使不朽，使名垂千古（尤指通过文学艺术作品等）

ex.en: The poet fell in love with her and immortalized her in his verse.
ex.cn: 诗人爱上了她，并以诗歌使她名传后世。

senses.def: that cannot be moved

ex.en: an immovable object
ex.cn: 固定的物体

senses.def: impossible to change or persuade

ex.en: On this issue he is completely immovable.
ex.cn: 他在这个问题上坚定不移。

senses.def: that cannot catch or be affected by a particular disease or illness

ex.en: Adults are often immune to German measles.
ex.cn: 成人往往对风疹有免疫力。

senses.def: not affected by sth

ex.en: You'll eventually become immune to criticism.
ex.cn: 你终究会变得不在乎批评了。

senses.def: protected from sth and therefore able to avoid it

ex.en: No one should be immune from prosecution.
ex.cn: 任何人都不应免于被起诉。

senses.def: the reaction of the body to the presence of an antigen (= a substance that can cause disease)
senses.chn: 免疫应答（机体对抗原的应答）

senses.def: the system in your body that produces substances to help it fight against infection and disease
the body's ability to avoid or not be affected by infection and disease

ex.en: immunity to infection
ex.cn: 对传染病的免疫力

ex.en: The vaccine provides longer immunity against flu.
ex.cn: 这种疫苗对流感的免疫效力时间较长。

senses.def: the state of being protected from sth

ex.en: The spies were all granted immunity from prosecution.
ex.cn: 这些间谍都获得免予公诉。

ex.en: parliamentary/congressional immunity (= protection against particular laws that is given to politicians)
ex.cn: 议会／国会豁免权

ex.en: Officials of all member states receive certain privileges and immunities.
ex.cn: 各成员国的官员均享有某些特权和豁免权。

example.en: immunity to infection
example.cn: 对传染病的免疫力

example.en: The vaccine provides longer immunity against flu.
example.cn: 这种疫苗对流感的免疫效力时间较长。

senses.def: to protect a person or an animal from a disease, especially by giving them an injection of a vaccine
a medical condition in which your body does not have the normal ability to resist infection

ex.en: human immunodeficiency virus or HIV
ex.cn: 人体免疫缺陷病毒，即 HIV

senses.def: the scientific study of protection against disease
the act of stopping the body from reacting against antigens, for example in order to prevent the body from rejecting a new organ
to shut sb in a place so that they cannot get out
that cannot be changed; that will never change
senses.chn: 不可改变的；永恒不变的

senses.def: (used especially in text messages, emails, etc. to introduce your opinion about sth) in my (humble) opinion
senses.chn: 依我看，依拙见（全写为 in my (humble) opinion，尤用于短信、电邮等）

ex.en: It's a nice performance, not among his best, IMO.
ex.cn: 依愚见，这是个不错的演出，但不算他的最佳表现。

senses.def: (in stories) a small creature like a little man, that has magic powers and behaves badly
a child who behaves badly, but not in a serious way
the powerful effect that sth has on sb/sth

ex.en: the environmental impact of tourism
ex.cn: 旅游事业对环境的巨大影响

ex.en: The report assesses the impact of AIDS on the gay community.
ex.cn: 这个报告评估了艾滋病对同性恋群体的影响。

ex.en: Her speech made a profound impact on everyone.
ex.cn: 她的讲话对每个人都有深远的影响。

ex.en: Businesses are beginning to feel the full impact of the recession.
ex.cn: 工商企业开始感受到了经济衰退的全面冲击。

senses.def: the act of one object hitting another; the force with which this happens

ex.en: craters made by meteorite impacts
ex.cn: 陨石撞击而成的陨石坑

ex.en: The impact of the blow knocked Jack off balance.
ex.cn: 这一记猛击把杰克打了个趔趄。

ex.en: The bomb explodes on impact (= when it hits something).
ex.cn: 炸弹受到撞击就爆炸。

ex.en: The car is fitted with side impact bars (= to protect it from a blow from the side).
ex.cn: 这辆车的两侧都安装了保险杠。

senses.def: to have an effect on sth

ex.en: Her father's death impacted greatly on her childhood years.
ex.cn: 父亲去世对她的童年造成巨大影响。

ex.en: The company's performance was impacted by the high value of the pound.
ex.cn: 公司的业绩受到了英镑高值的冲击。

senses.def: to hit sth with great force

example.en: Her father's death impacted greatly on her childhood years.
example.cn: 父亲去世对她的童年造成巨大影响。

example.en: The company's performance was impacted by the high value of the pound.
example.cn: 公司的业绩受到了英镑高值的冲击。

senses.def: that cannot grow correctly because it is under another tooth
to damage sth or make sth worse

ex.en: The fire badly damaged the town hall.
ex.cn: 火灾使市政厅遭到严重破坏。

ex.en: emotionally damaged children
ex.cn: 感情上受伤害的孩子

ex.en: Hard work never hurt anyone.
ex.cn: 努力工作绝无害处。

ex.en: Pollution can harm marine life.
ex.cn: 污染会危及海洋生物。

ex.en: It won't hurt him to have to wait a bit.
ex.cn: 等上一会儿对他无妨。

ex.en: Even one drink can impair driving performance.
ex.cn: 即使一杯酒也可能影响驾驶操作。

senses.def: damaged or not functioning normally
senses.chn: 受损的；损坏的；出毛病的

ex.en: impaired vision/memory
ex.cn: 受损的视力／记忆力

senses.def: having the type of physical or mental problem mentioned
senses.chn: 有（身体或智力）缺陷的；有…障碍的

ex.en: hearing-impaired children
ex.cn: 听力受损的儿童

ex.en: Nowadays we say someone is 'speech-impaired', not dumb.
ex.cn: 现在我们说某个人 “有语言障碍”，而不说是哑巴。

ex.en: mentally disabled
ex.cn: 精神伤残的

ex.en: learning disabilities
ex.cn: 学习障碍

ex.en: The museum has special facilities for blind and partially sighted visitors.
ex.cn: 博物馆有专门设备供失明和视力有缺陷的参观者使用。

senses.def: the state of having a physical or mental condition which means that part of your body or brain does not work correctly; a particular condition of this sort
senses.chn: （身体或智力方面的）缺陷，障碍，损伤；某种缺陷

ex.en: impairment of the functions of the kidney
ex.cn: 肾功能障碍

ex.en: visual impairments
ex.cn: 视力受损

senses.def: an African antelope with curled horns
senses.chn: 黑斑羚（栖息在非洲，角弯曲）

senses.def: to push a sharp pointed object through sth

ex.en: She impaled a lump of meat on her fork.
ex.cn: 她用叉子叉起一块肉。

senses.def: if you impale yourself on sth, or are impaled on it, you have a sharp pointed object pushed into you and you may be caught somewhere by it

ex.en: He had fallen and been impaled on some iron railings.
ex.cn: 他摔下去，穿在了铁栏杆上。

senses.def: that cannot be felt physically
senses.chn: 触摸不到的；感觉不着的

senses.def: very difficult to understand
to choose the members of a jury in a court case; to choose sb as a member of a jury
senses.chn: 选任（陪审员）；选任…为陪审员

senses.def: to pass information, knowledge, etc. to other people
to give a particular quality to sth

ex.en: The spice imparts an Eastern flavour to the dish.
ex.cn: 这种调味品给菜肴添加了一种东方风味。

senses.def: not supporting one person or group more than another
senses.chn: 公正的；不偏不倚的；中立的

ex.en: an impartial inquiry/observer
ex.cn: 公正的调查／观察者

ex.en: to give impartial advice
ex.cn: 提出不偏不倚的建议

ex.en: As chairman, I must remain impartial.
ex.cn: 作为主席，我必须保持中立。

senses.def: impossible to travel on or through, especially because it is in bad condition or it has been blocked by sth
senses.chn: 不能通行的（尤指因路况恶劣或被阻断）

senses.def: a difficult situation in which no progress can be made because the people involved cannot agree what to do

ex.en: to break/end the impasse
ex.cn: 打破／结束僵局

ex.en: Negotiations have reached an impasse.
ex.cn: 谈判已陷入僵局。

senses.def: showing strong feelings about sth

ex.en: an impassioned plea/speech/defence
ex.cn: 热切的恳求；充满激情的讲话／辩护

senses.def: not showing any feeling or emotion
senses.chn: 无表情的；无动于衷的；不动声色的

ex.en: her impassive expression/face
ex.cn: 她冷漠的表情／面容

senses.def: a painting technique in which the paint is put on so thickly that it stands out from the surface
senses.chn: 厚涂法（使用大量颜料堆叠，使其高出画布或画板表面）

senses.def: a picture painted using this method
annoyed or irritated by sb/sth, especially because you have to wait for a long time

ex.cn: 很难理解这份声明的全部含意。

example.en: The country has to import most of its raw materials.
example.cn: 这个国家大多数原料依赖进口。

example.en: goods imported from Japan into the US
example.cn: 从日本输入到美国的货品

senses.def: the quality of being important

ex.cn: 我要宣布一件重要的事情。

ex.cn: 倾听是这项工作的一个重要部分。

ex.cn: 美国艺术的最有价值的收藏品之一

ex.cn: 遵照厂家的说明很重要。

senses.def: having great influence or authority

ex.cn: 举足轻重的一位队员

ex.cn: 他喜欢感到自己很重要。

example.en: It's very important to me that you should be there.
example.cn: 你应该到场，这对我很重要。

senses.def: a person, company, etc. that buys goods from another country in order to sell them in their own country
senses.chn: 从事进口的人（或公司等）；进口商

ex.cn: 总部设在伦敦的意大利食品进口商

senses.chn: 推行，采用（规章制度）；强制实行

ex.cn: 当局开始对燃油征收一项新税。

ex.cn: 这个制度给很多人增加了额外的经济负担。

senses.chn: 使（别人）接受自己的意见

ex.cn: 她并不想勉强家人接受自己的价值观。

ex.cn: 显而易见，有少数几个人设法把自己的意志强加于别人。

ex.cn: “你一定得留下吃午饭。” “唔，谢谢，但我不想添麻烦…”

ex.cn: 大家都欺负戴夫脾气好。

ex.cn: 欧洲文明是最先传播到全世界的。

example.en: Everyone imposes on Dave's good nature.
example.cn: 大家都欺负戴夫脾气好。

senses.def: impressive to look at; making a strong impression

ex.cn: 我在八点之前不可能赶到那里。

ex.cn: 我觉得无法对她撒谎。

ex.en: an impossible dream/goal
ex.cn: 无法实现的梦想／目标

ex.cn: 我陷入了进退维谷的境地。

ex.cn: 说实话，你有时真令人难以忍受。

ex.cn: 没有主席的支持，委员会是无能为力的。

ex.cn: 这些变革很可能使单亲家庭更加贫困。

ex.cn: 集约耕作使土壤变得贫瘠。

ex.cn: 贫困的农民

ex.cn: 这个城市的贫民区

ex.cn: 他们穷得没钱给孩子买鞋穿。

ex.cn: 该社区社会地位低下的贫困阶层

ex.cn: 这是一个为贫困孩子提供援助的慈善机构。

ex.cn: 成千上万赤贫的农民急切盼望搬到城里去。

ex.cn: 不可能每一次都征求每个成员的意见。

senses.def: not sensible or realistic

ex.cn: 认为我们能在两个月之内完成这项工作，这完全是不切实际的。

senses.chn: 手不灵巧的；不善于规划（或组织）的

not giving exact details or making sth clear
senses.chn: 不确切的；不精确的；不明确的

ex.en: an imprecise definition
ex.cn: 不确切的定义

ex.en: imprecise information
ex.cn: 不准确的信息

ex.en: The witness's descriptions were too imprecise to be of any real value.
ex.cn: 证人的描述太不明确，没有任何实际价值。

senses.chn: 坚不可摧的；牢不可破的

ex.en: an impregnable fortress
ex.cn: 坚不可摧的要塞

senses.chn: 不可战胜的；难以改变的

ex.cn: 这个队以 5:1 的绝对优势领先。

ex.cn: 垫子上满是杀虫剂。

a person who arranges plays in the theatre, etc., especially a person who manages a theatre, opera or ballet company
senses.chn: （剧院、歌剧或芭蕾舞团的）经理

ex.cn: 我们和数名申请人进行了面谈，但都没有给我们留下什么印象。

ex.en: The Grand Canyon never fails to impress.
ex.cn: 大峡谷永远让人叹为观止。

ex.en: His sincerity impressed her.
ex.cn: 他的真诚打动了她。

ex.en: He impressed her with his sincerity.
ex.cn: 他的真诚打动了她。

ex.en: It impressed me that she remembered my name.
ex.cn: 令我佩服的是她记得我的名字。

ex.en: I was impressed that she remembered my name.
ex.cn: 令我佩服的是她记得我的名字。

senses.def: to make sb understand how important, serious, etc. sth is by emphasizing it
senses.chn: 使意识到（重要性或严肃性等）

ex.cn: 他让我们认识到立刻采取行动的必要。

ex.cn: 她的话语我铭记在心里。

example.cn: 我们和数名申请人进行了面谈，但都没有给我们留下什么印象。

example.en: He impressed her with his sincerity.
example.cn: 他的真诚打动了她。

example.cn: 令我佩服的是她记得我的名字。

example.cn: 令我佩服的是她记得我的名字。

ex.cn: 我得承认我很佩服。

ex.cn: 我们都被她的热情打动了。

ex.cn: 果然不出所料，她对那幅油画产生了兴趣。

example.en: We were all impressed by her enthusiasm.
example.cn: 我们都被她的热情打动了。

ex.en: a general/an overall impression
ex.cn: 总的／整体印象

ex.en: an initial/a lasting impression
ex.cn: 初次／持久的印象

ex.cn: 对某人／某事物的印象好／不好

ex.cn: 他给我的第一印象不错。

ex.cn: 她给人的印象是特别忙。

ex.cn: 我并不觉得他们不满于当时的状况。

ex.cn: 大的影响

ex.cn: 他的印度之行对他的触动很大。

ex.cn: 我的话丝毫没有对她起作用。

ex.cn: 你如果真的想给人留下好印象，就得表现得更好。

ex.cn: 这是一位艺术家对未来新运动场作的印象画。

ex.cn: 他滑稽地模仿了汤姆 · 汉克斯。

ex.cn: 我还以为已经完工了呢。

ex.cn: 你认为他们会来吗？

ex.cn: 嗯，我喜欢这个。你认为怎么样？

ex.en: Police believe (that) the man may be armed.
ex.cn: 警方认为那个人可能携有武器。

ex.en: Police believe…
ex.cn: 警方认为…

ex.en: I think…
ex.cn: 我认为…

example.en: to get a good/bad impression of sb/sth
example.cn: 对某人／某事物的印象好／不好

example.en: I did not get the impression that they were unhappy about the situation.
example.cn: 我并不觉得他们不满于当时的状况。

example.en: His trip to India made a strong impression on him.
example.cn: 他的印度之行对他的触动很大。

senses.def: easily influenced or affected by sb/sth

ex.en: children at an impressionable age
ex.cn: 处于易受外界影响的年龄的儿童

senses.def: an artist who paints in the style of Impressionism

ex.en: Impressionists such as Monet and Pissarro
ex.cn: 莫奈和毕沙罗等的印象派画家

senses.def: a person who entertains people by copying the way a famous person speaks or behaves
senses.chn: 模仿演员（常模仿名人言行）

senses.def: making you feel admiration, because they are very large, good, skilful, etc.

ex.cn: 有高塔的壮观建筑

ex.en: an impressive performance
ex.cn: 令人难忘的演出

ex.en: one of the most impressive novels of recent years
ex.cn: 近年来给人印象最深的小说之一

ex.en: She was very impressive in the interview.
ex.cn: 她在面试中表现得十分出色。

senses.def: official approval of sth, given by a person in a position of authority
to have a great effect on sth so that it cannot be forgotten, changed, etc.
senses.chn: 产生重大影响；铭刻；使铭记

ex.en: The terrible scenes were indelibly imprinted on his mind.
ex.cn: 那些恐怖场面深深地铭刻在他的心中。

senses.def: to print or press a mark or design onto a surface

ex.en: clothes imprinted with the logos of sports teams
ex.cn: 印着运动队标志的衣服

senses.def: a mark made by pressing or stamping sth onto a surface

ex.en: the imprint of a foot in the sand
ex.cn: 沙滩上的足迹

senses.def: the lasting effect that a person or an experience has on a place or a situation
the name of the publisher of a book, usually printed below the title on the first page
senses.chn: 出版商名称（通常印在第一页的书名下面）

ex.cn: 他们因持有毒品而被监禁。

ex.en: Some young mothers feel imprisoned in their own homes.
ex.cn: 有些年轻的母亲感到待在家里如同坐牢。

senses.def: not likely to be true or to happen
senses.chn: 不大可能真实的（或发生的）；不大可能的

ex.cn: 大概不是真实的故事

ex.cn: 一切听上去很荒唐。

ex.en: It seems improbable that the current situation will continue.
ex.cn: 当前的局势似乎不大可能继续下去。

senses.def: seeming strange because it is not what you would expect

ex.en: Her hair was an improbable shade of yellow.
ex.cn: 她的头发带有怪怪的黄色。

example.cn: 当前的局势似乎不大可能继续下去。

senses.def: done without preparation or planning
senses.chn: 无准备的；即兴的；即席的

ex.en: an impromptu speech
ex.cn: 即兴讲演

ex.cn: 不正当的商业手法

ex.cn: 不道德的行为

ex.cn: 我们的关系没有什么不正当的。

senses.def: wrong; not correct

ex.cn: 药物的误用

senses.def: a fraction in which the top number is greater than the bottom number, for example 7/6

senses.chn: （身居要职者）不诚实（或不正当、不合适）的行为举止

senses.def: to become better than before; to make sth/sb better than before

ex.cn: 手术后他的生活质量大大改善了。

ex.en: The doctor says she should continue to improve (= after an illness).
ex.cn: 医生说她还会继续康复。

ex.cn: 提高水平

ex.cn: 公司需要在所有这些方面改善业绩。

ex.cn: 我得提高我的法语水平。

ex.cn: 我们的业绩的确超过了去年的数字。

example.cn: 提高水平

ex.cn: 销售额持续显示出增加的迹象。

ex.cn: 我们期望来年会有更进一步的改善。

ex.cn: 你的工作尚有改进的余地。

ex.cn: 重要的／重大的／巨大的改进

ex.en: a slight/steady improvement
ex.cn: 轻微的／稳定的提升

ex.en: an improvement in Anglo-German relations
ex.cn: 英德关系的改善

ex.en: This is a great improvement on your previous work.
ex.cn: 你的工作比先前有很大进步。

ex.en: an improvised speech
ex.cn: 即席讲演

example.en: We improvised some shelves out of planks of wood and bricks.
example.cn: 我们用木板和砖头临时搭了些架子。

example.en: He improvised on the melody.
example.cn: 他即兴演奏了那首曲子。

senses.def: not wise or sensible

ex.cn: 他突然心血来潮，想站起来唱歌。

ex.cn: 我强忍着没有笑出来。

ex.cn: 她的第一个念头就是逃走。

senses.def: a force or movement of energy that causes sth else to react

ex.en: nerve/electrical impulses
ex.cn: 神经冲动；电路脉冲

senses.def: something that causes sb/sth to do sth or to develop and make progress

ex.cn: 给予挣扎中的汽车工业一点刺激

senses.def: buying goods without planning to do so in advance, and without thinking about it carefully
a strong desire to do sth
a reason for doing sth

ex.cn: 缺少食物和水促使他们加快了速度。

senses.def: acting suddenly without thinking carefully about what might happen because of what you are doing
senses.chn: 凭冲动行事的；易冲动的

ex.cn: 冲动的决定／姿态

ex.cn: 你太冲动了！

ex.cn: 他生性冲动。

senses.def: if a person does sth bad with impunity, they do not get punished for what they have done

ex.cn: 过滤器会滤掉水中的大部分杂质。

senses.def: the state of being dirty or not pure

senses.chn: （常指不公正地把责任等）归咎于

senses.def: used when you are apologizing for sth

ex.cn: 对不起，我忘了。

ex.cn: 哟，对不起。我是不是拿了你想要的那个？

ex.cn: 很抱歉。我明天不行。

ex.cn: 对不起，我不同意。

ex.cn: 恕我直言，我看你还是不去为好。

ex.cn: 我只能遗憾地告诉你，你不及格。

ex.cn: 我敢说，这并不便宜！

ex.cn: 我可以肯定地说，那正是她的原话。

ex.cn: 孩子们在街上玩。

ex.cn: 它放在那个抽屉里。

ex.cn: 她躺在床上。

ex.cn: 把钥匙留在锁孔里。

ex.cn: 把这东西浸泡在冷水里。

ex.cn: 他把毛刷在涂料里蘸了蘸。

ex.cn: 她钻进汽车里，开走了。

ex.cn: 收藏品中的所有画作

ex.cn: 我在他身上看到了他父亲的气质。

ex.cn: 在 18 世纪

ex.cn: 在春天／夏天／秋天／冬天

ex.cn: 在秋天

ex.en: in March
ex.cn: 在三月

ex.cn: 在上午／下午／晚上

ex.cn: 只需一周的时间就会准备好。

ex.cn: 她花了三个星期就学会开车。

ex.cn: 我有好些年没见过他了。

ex.cn: 这是我十天来收到的第一封信。

ex.cn: 穿着他们最好的衣服

ex.cn: 穿着制服

ex.cn: 她穿着一身黑。

ex.cn: 我们冒雨出去了。

ex.cn: 他独自坐在黑暗中。

ex.cn: 我恋爱了！

ex.cn: 这所房子保养得不错。

ex.cn: 我必须整理整理我的事务。

ex.cn: 一名三十多岁的男子

ex.cn: 水仙花正盛开。

ex.cn: 参加演戏

ex.cn: 他在军队服役。

ex.cn: 她从事计算机业。

ex.cn: 从商

ex.cn: 分为三部的小说

ex.cn: 把它卷成一个球。

ex.cn: 他们一排一排地坐着。

ex.cn: 用英语说吧。

ex.cn: 她用铅笔写的。

ex.cn: 把它写下来。

ex.cn: 我用现金支付。

ex.cn: 他大声说话。

ex.cn: 她并不缺乏勇气。

ex.cn: 矿藏丰富的国家

ex.cn: 三米长

ex.cn: 她在抢救落水的儿童时，自己差点丧命。

ex.cn: 五分之一的坡度

ex.cn: 每英镑 22 便士的税率

ex.cn: 她打开门进去了。

ex.cn: 无限的

ex.cn: 不合逻辑的

ex.cn: 不道德地

ex.cn: 使愤怒

ex.cn: 使陷于危险

ex.cn: 这个寺庙现在不对公众开放了。

example.en: The temple is now inaccessible to the public.
example.cn: 这个寺庙现在不对公众开放了。

ex.cn: 不准确的信息

ex.cn: 我们所有的地图误差都非常大。

ex.cn: 只要按一下按键就可以看到你最喜欢的角色表演。

ex.cn: 供应短缺

example.cn: 这个系统要完成它的任务还不够完善。

example.en: The food supplies are inadequate to meet the needs of the hungry.
example.cn: 食物供应还不足以应付饥民的需求。

ex.cn: 如果能找到另外一份工作，我马上就走。

example.en: I inched the car forward.

senses.chn: （所说的话）不只一个意思；在很多方面

ex.en: With the first goal he used his head in more ways than one.
ex.cn: 他进第一个球时从多方面动了脑筋。

senses.def: stored and not in use, often for a long time
used when you are giving your opinion

ex.en: That's cheating in my book.
ex.cn: 依我看那是欺骗。

senses.def: a pub, usually in the country and often one where people can stay the night
senses.chn: （通常指乡村的，常可夜宿的）小酒店

senses.def: a small hotel, usually in the country
used in the names of many pubs, hotels and restaurants
senses.chn: （用于客栈、旅馆和饭店的名称中）

ex.en: Holiday Inn
ex.cn: 假日酒店

senses.def: officially recognized but not existing in reality

ex.en: He's party leader in name only.
ex.cn: 他只是名义上的政党领袖。

senses.def: the organs inside the body of a person or an animal, especially the stomach
the parts inside a machine
that you have when you are born
senses.chn: 天生的；先天的；与生俱来的

ex.en: the innate ability to learn
ex.cn: 天生的学习能力

senses.def: inside; towards or close to the centre of a place
senses.chn: 里面的；向内的；内部的；接近中心的

ex.en: an inner courtyard
ex.cn: 内院

ex.en: inner London
ex.cn: 伦敦市中心区

ex.en: the inner ear
ex.cn: 内耳

senses.def: private and secret; not expressed or shown to other people
senses.chn: 内心的；未表达出来的；隐藏的

ex.en: She doesn't reveal much of her inner self.
ex.cn: 她不大流露她的内心自我。

senses.def: the small group of people who have a lot of power in an organization, or who control it
the part near the centre of a large city, which often has social problems

ex.en: There are huge problems in our inner cities.
ex.cn: 我们各个内城区存在着许多大的问题。

ex.en: an inner-city area/school
ex.cn: 内城区的地区／学校

senses.def: the parts of the ear which form the organs of balance and hearing, including the cochlea
senses.chn: 内耳，迷路（包括听觉器官和平衡器官）

senses.def: most private, personal and secret

ex.en: I could not express my innermost feelings to anyone.
ex.cn: 我不能向任何人表达我内心深处的感情。

senses.def: nearest to the centre or inside of sth
senses.chn: 最靠近中心的；最深处的

ex.en: the innermost shrine of the temple
ex.cn: 神殿最深处的圣坛

senses.def: a rubber tube filled with air inside a tyre
one of the nine periods of a game in which each team has a turn at batting
a period of time in a game during which a team or a single player is batting
used about sb who has died to say that they had a long life
senses.chn: （用以指死者）…够长寿了，终其天年

senses.def: a way of saying 'isn't it'

ex.en: Cold, innit?
ex.cn: 很冷，是不是？

senses.def: a way of saying any question tag, such as 'don't you?' or 'haven't you?'

ex.en: You got it, innit?
ex.cn: 你明白了，是吗？

senses.def: a person who owns or manages an inn
senses.chn: 客栈老板；（乡村）酒铺掌柜

senses.def: the fact of not being guilty of a crime, etc.

ex.en: She protested her innocence (= said repeatedly that she was innocent).
ex.cn: 她一再申明自己是无辜的。

ex.en: This new evidence will prove their innocence.
ex.cn: 这一新的证据将证明他们的清白。

ex.en: I asked if she was married in all innocence (= without knowing it was likely to offend or upset her).
ex.cn: 我问她结婚了没有，完全没有恶意。

senses.def: lack of knowledge and experience of the world, especially of evil or unpleasant things

ex.en: Children lose their innocence as they grow older.
ex.cn: 儿童随着年龄的增长而失去其天真。

senses.def: not guilty of a crime, etc.; not having done sth wrong

ex.en: They have imprisoned an innocent man.
ex.cn: 他们监禁了一名无辜的男子。

ex.en: She was found innocent of any crime.
ex.cn: 她获判无罪。

ex.en: He was the innocent party (= person) in the breakdown of the marriage.
ex.cn: 他们的婚姻破裂，他是无过错的一方。

senses.def: suffering harm or being killed because of a crime, war, etc. although not directly involved in it
senses.chn: 无辜受害的；成为牺牲品的

ex.en: an innocent bystander
ex.cn: 无辜受害的旁观者

ex.en: innocent victims of a bomb blast
ex.cn: 炸弹爆炸中的无辜受害者

senses.def: having little experience of the world, especially of sexual matters, or of evil or unpleasant things

ex.en: an innocent young child
ex.cn: 天真无邪的小孩子

senses.def: not intended to cause harm or upset sb
senses.chn: 无恶意的；无冒犯之意的

ex.en: It was all innocent fun.
ex.cn: 那不过是些无恶意的玩笑。

ex.en: It was a perfectly innocent remark.
ex.cn: 那是一句毫无冒犯之意的话。

senses.def: an innocent person, especially a young child
senses.chn: 无辜者，单纯的人（尤指天真无邪的孩子）

example.en: She was found innocent of any crime.
example.cn: 她获判无罪。

senses.def: not intended or likely to offend or upset anyone

ex.en: It seemed a perfectly innocuous remark.
ex.cn: 那像是一句毫无恶意的话。

senses.def: not harmful or dangerous

ex.en: an innocuous substance
ex.cn: 无害物质

senses.def: in a way that is not intended or likely to offend or upset anyone

ex.en: It all began innocuously enough with an enquiry from a new customer.
ex.cn: 这一切都始于一个新客户毫无恶意的问询。

senses.def: to a large extent or degree; to some, etc. extent or degree
senses.chn: 在很大（或某种、同样等）程度上

ex.en: The introduction of a new tax accounted in no small measure for the downfall of the government.
ex.cn: 这届政府的垮台在很大程度上归因于征收一种新税。

ex.en: Our thanks are due in equal measure to every member of the team.
ex.cn: 我们同样感谢每一位队员。

senses.def: clearly and strongly
senses.chn: 明确有力地；毫不含糊地

ex.en: I told him what I thought of him in no uncertain terms.
ex.cn: 我直言不讳地说出了我对他的看法。

senses.def: to introduce new things, ideas or ways of doing sth
senses.chn: 引入（新事物、思想或方法）；创新；改革

ex.en: We must constantly adapt and innovate to ensure success in a growing market.
ex.cn: 我们必须不时地适应并创新，以确保在不断扩大的市场中取得成功。

ex.en: to innovate new products
ex.cn: 创造新产品

example.en: to innovate new products
example.cn: 创造新产品

senses.def: the introduction of new things, ideas or ways of doing sth
senses.chn: （新事物、思想或方法的）创造；创新；改革

ex.en: an age of technological innovation
ex.cn: 技术革新的时代

senses.def: a new idea, way of doing sth, etc. that has been introduced or discovered

ex.en: recent innovations in steel-making technology
ex.cn: 新近的炼钢技术革新

senses.def: introducing or using new ideas, ways of doing sth, etc.
senses.chn: 引进新思想的；采用新方法的；革新的；创新的

ex.en: There will be a prize for the most innovative design.
ex.cn: 将设立一项最具创意设计奖。

senses.def: an indirect remark about sb/sth, usually suggesting sth bad or rude; the use of remarks like this

ex.en: innuendoes about her private life
ex.cn: 对她私生活含沙射影的指责

ex.en: The song is full of sexual innuendo.
ex.cn: 那首歌充满了性的暗示。

senses.def: too many to be counted; very many

ex.en: Innumerable books have been written on the subject.
ex.cn: 已经有无数书籍写过这个主题。

senses.def: unable to count or do simple mathematics
senses.chn: 不会数数的；不会计算的；不懂算术的

senses.def: to protect a person or an animal from catching a particular disease by injecting them with a mild form of the disease
not likely to offend or upset anyone
senses.chn: 不会冒犯人的；不讨人嫌的

ex.en: a shy, inoffensive young man
ex.cn: 腼腆温和的青年男子

senses.def: used to say that sb/sth has different roles, contains different things or is used for different purposes
senses.chn: 集于一身（或一体）；多功能；多用途

ex.en: She's a mother and company director in one.
ex.cn: 她既是母亲又是公司董事。

ex.en: It's a public relations office, a press office and a private office all in one.
ex.cn: 那儿既是公关办公室，也是新闻办公室，又是私人办公室：三合一。

senses.def: all together on one occasion

ex.en: I'd rather do the journey in one go, and not stop on the way.
ex.cn: 我宁愿一次走完全程，中途不停。

ex.en: They ate the packet of biscuits all in one go.
ex.cn: 他们一下子把那包饼干全吃光了。

senses.def: to some extent; not completely
senses.chn: 在某种程度上；不完全地

ex.en: In a way it was one of our biggest mistakes.
ex.cn: 从某种意义上来说，这是我们所犯的最大错误之一。

senses.def: not able to be cured by a medical operation

ex.en: an inoperable brain tumour
ex.cn: 不能手术治疗的脑瘤

senses.def: that cannot be used or made to work; not practical
senses.chn: 无法使用的；不能实行的；不实用的

ex.en: The policy was thought to be inoperable.
ex.cn: 这项政策被认为行不通。

senses.def: working, being used or having an effect

ex.en: The system has been in operation for six months.
ex.cn: 这个系统已经运行六个月了。

ex.en: Temporary traffic controls are in operation on New Road.
ex.cn: 新路正在实施临时交通管制。

senses.def: not valid or able to be used
not working; not functioning correctly
senses.chn: 不运转的；运行不正常的

senses.def: happening at a bad time
senses.chn: 不合时宜的；不是时候的

ex.en: They arrived at an inopportune moment.
ex.cn: 他们到的不是时候。

senses.def: forming part of a parliament but not part of the government
that can be used because it is all correct and legal

ex.en: Is your work permit in order?
ex.cn: 你的工作许可证有效吗？

senses.def: as it should be

ex.en: Is everything in order, sir?
ex.cn: 一切都正常吗，先生？

senses.def: if sth is in order, it is a suitable thing to do or say on a particular occasion

ex.en: I think a drink would be in order.
ex.cn: 我想应该喝杯饮料了吧。

senses.def: so that sth can happen

ex.en: All those concerned must work together in order that agreement can be reached on this issue.
ex.cn: 一切有关人员必须通力合作，以便能在这个问题上达成协议。

senses.def: with the purpose or intention of doing or achieving sth

ex.en: She arrived early in order to get a good seat.
ex.cn: 她早早到场，好找个好位置。

ex.en: In order to get a complete picture, further information is needed.
ex.cn: 为掌握全面情况，还需要详细资料。

ex.en: This diagram illustrates the process of paper-making./This diagram shows how paper is made.
ex.cn: 这个图说明了造纸的过程。

ex.en: First / First of all, logs are delivered to a paper mill, where the bark is removed and the wood is cut into small chips.
ex.cn: 首先，原木被运送到造纸厂，在那里去掉树皮，然后被切成木片。

ex.en: Next / Second, the wood chips are pulped, either using chemicals or in a pulping machine.
ex.cn: 接下来，用化学品或磨浆机把木片化成浆。

ex.en: Pulping breaks down the internal structure of the wood and enables / allows the natural oils to be removed.
ex.cn: 制浆过程使木材的内部结构分解，从而去除木材里的天然油。

senses.def: far more than is usual or expected
senses.chn: 过度的；过分的；超乎预料的

senses.def: not consisting of or coming from any living substances

ex.en: inorganic fertilizers
ex.cn: 无机肥料

senses.def: the branch of chemistry that deals with substances that do not contain carbon
used to introduce an explanation of sth
senses.chn: 换句话说；也就是说；换言之

ex.en: They asked him to leave—in other words he was fired.
ex.cn: 他们请他走人，也就是说，他被解雇了。

ex.en: Some poems are mnemonics, i.e. they are designed to help you remember something.
ex.cn: 有些诗歌是记忆代码，即是说，其目的是帮助人们记起某事。

ex.en: Some poems are mnemonics, that is to say, they are designed to help you remember something.
ex.cn: 有些诗歌是记忆代码，就是说，其目的是帮助人们记起某事。

ex.en: Mnemonic poems, that is poems designed to help you remember something, are an excellent way to learn lists.
ex.cn: 记事诗，即帮助人记起事情的诗歌，是记住一系列事物的极佳方式。

ex.en: A limerick's rhyme scheme is A–A–B–B–A. In other words, the first, second, and fifth lines all rhyme with one another, while the third and fourth lines have their own rhyme.
ex.cn: 五行打油诗的韵律是 A-A-B-B-A。就是说，第一行、第二行和第五行押一个韵，而第三行和第四行押另一个韵。

ex.en: In this exercise the reader is encouraged to work out the meaning, or rather the range of meanings, of the poem.
ex.cn: 这个练习鼓励读者弄清这首诗的意思，更确切地说是弄清其几种含意。

senses.def: involved in sth that is too difficult for you to deal with

ex.en: After a week in the new job, I soon realized that I was in over my head.
ex.cn: 新工作刚做了一个星期，我便意识到自己做不了。

senses.def: in groups of two objects or people

ex.en: Students worked in pairs on the project.
ex.cn: 学生两人一组做这个项目。

senses.def: partly; to some extent

ex.en: Her success was due in part to luck.
ex.cn: 她的成功在某种程度上是由于运气好。

senses.def: especially or particularly

ex.en: He loves science fiction in particular.
ex.cn: 他特别喜爱科幻小说。

ex.en: This case emphasizes / highlights the importance of honest communication between managers and employees.
ex.cn: 这个事例凸显出经理与员工之间坦诚交流的重要性。

ex.en: Effective communication skills are essential / crucial / vital.
ex.cn: 有效的交流技巧是至关重要的。

ex.en: It should be noted that this study considers only verbal communication. Non-verbal communication is not dealt with here.
ex.cn: 应该注意的是本研究只考查了言语交流，在此没有涉及非言语交流。

ex.en: It is important to remember that / An important point to remember is that non-verbal communication plays a key role in getting your message across.
ex.cn: 非言语交流在传递信息过程中起着重要的作用，记住这一点非常重要。

ex.en: Communication is not only about the words you use but also your body language and, especially / above all, the effectiveness with which you listen.
ex.cn: 交流不仅涉及使用的词语，同时也涉及身体语言，尤其与能否有效听取对方的话有关。

senses.def: special or specific

ex.en: Peter was lying on the sofa doing nothing in particular.
ex.cn: 彼得躺在沙发上，无所事事。

ex.en: Is there anything in particular you'd like for dinner?
ex.cn: 晚饭你有具体想吃的吗？

ex.en: She directed the question at no one in particular.
ex.cn: 她的问题并没有针对任何个人。

senses.def: done or said while you are giving your attention to sth else

ex.en: He only mentioned it in passing and didn't give any details.
ex.cn: 他只是随口提及而已，并没有谈任何细节。

senses.def: a person who stays in a hospital while receiving treatment
if sth is in pawn, it has been pawned

ex.en: All her jewellery was in pawn.
ex.cn: 她的首饰全典当了。

senses.def: for all time in the future

ex.en: They do not own the land in perpetuity.
ex.cn: 他们并不永久拥有这片土地。

senses.def: if you do sth in person, you go somewhere and do it yourself, instead of doing it by letter, asking sb else to do it, etc.
in the correct position; ready for sth

ex.en: Carefully lay each slab in place.
ex.cn: 要仔细铺好每一块石板。

ex.en: The receiver had already clicked into place.
ex.cn: 听筒咔的一声放回原位了。

senses.def: working or ready to work

ex.en: All the arrangements are now in place for their visit.
ex.cn: 他们来访的一切事宜都安排好了。

senses.def: simply and clearly expressed, without using technical language
used to say what is true in a situation

ex.en: In point of fact, she is their adopted daughter.
ex.cn: 实际上，她是他们的养女。

senses.def: in reality

ex.en: Prisoners have legal rights, but in practice these rights are not always respected.
ex.cn: 囚犯虽有合法的权利，但实际上这些权利常未受到尊重。

senses.def: if something can be done in principle, there is no good reason why it should not be done although it has not yet been done and there may be some difficulties

ex.en: In principle there is nothing that a human can do that a machine might not be able to do one day.
ex.cn: 原则上，总会有一天，凡是人能做的事，机器就能做。

senses.def: in general but not in detail

ex.en: They have agreed to the proposal in principle but we still have to negotiate the terms.
ex.cn: 他们已基本同意了这项提议，但我们还得磋商各项条款。

senses.def: still available from the company that publishes it
printed in a book, newspaper, etc.

ex.en: It was the first time he had seen his name in print.
ex.cn: 那是他第一次见到自己的名字被刊印出来。

senses.def: with nobody else present

ex.en: Is there somewhere we can discuss this in private?
ex.cn: 有没有什么地方能让我们单独谈谈这件事？

senses.def: happening at this time

ex.en: Work on the new offices is now in progress.
ex.cn: 新办公楼正在施工。

ex.en: Please be quiet—examination in progress.
ex.cn: 考试正在进行，请安静。

senses.def: when other people, especially people you do not know, are present
senses.chn: 公开地；在别人（尤指生人）面前

ex.en: She doesn't like to be seen in public without her make-up on.
ex.cn: 她不愿意未化妆就公开露面。

senses.def: in order to do sth; in the process of doing sth

ex.en: They may need to borrow money in pursuance of their legal action.
ex.cn: 他们在诉讼过程中可能需要借贷。

senses.def: time, knowledge, ideas, etc. that you put into work, a project, etc. in order to make it succeed; the act of putting sth in
senses.chn: 投入资源（指时间、知识、思想等）；投入；输入

ex.en: Her specialist input to the discussions has been very useful.
ex.cn: 她在这些讨论中提供的专家建议很有助益。

ex.en: I'd appreciate your input on this.
ex.cn: 我将感激你在这方面的投入。

ex.en: There has been a big input of resources into the project from industry.
ex.cn: 工业界对这个项目投入了大量资源。

senses.def: the act of putting information into a computer; the information that you put in

ex.en: data input
ex.cn: 数据输入

ex.en: This program accepts input from most word processors.
ex.cn: 这个程序可接受大多数文字处理系统输入的信息。

senses.def: a place or means for electricity, data, etc. to enter a machine or system
to put information into a computer

ex.en: to input text/data/figures
ex.cn: 把文本／数据／数字输入计算机

example.en: Her specialist input to the discussions has been very useful.
example.cn: 她在这些讨论中提供的专家建议很有助益。

example.en: There has been a big input of resources into the project from industry.
example.cn: 工业界对这个项目投入了大量资源。

senses.def: an official investigation to find out the cause of sb's death, especially when it has not happened naturally

ex.en: An inquest was held to discover the cause of death.
ex.cn: 对死亡原因进行了调查。

ex.en: a coroner's inquest into his death
ex.cn: 进行验尸以探究他的死因

senses.def: a discussion about sth that has failed

ex.en: An inquest was held on the team's poor performance.
ex.cn: 对该队在比赛中的差劲表现进行了检讨。

example.en: a coroner's inquest into his death
example.cn: 进行验尸以探究他的死因

senses.def: that is being discussed

ex.en: On the day in question we were in Cardiff.
ex.cn: 在所说的那一天，我们在加的夫。

senses.def: in doubt; uncertain

ex.en: The future of public transport is not in question.
ex.cn: 公共交通的未来发展是不容置疑的。

senses.def: the organization set up by the Roman Catholic Church to punish people who opposed its beliefs, especially from the 15th to the 17th century
senses.chn: （尤指 15 到 17 世纪天主教的）宗教裁判所，异端裁判所

senses.def: a series of questions that sb asks you, especially when they ask them in an unpleasant way
senses.chn: 一连串的提问；（尤指）盘问，责难

senses.def: asking too many questions and trying to find out about what other people are doing, etc.

ex.en: Don't be so inquisitive. It's none of your business!
ex.cn: 别这么追根问底的。这与你无关！

senses.def: very interested in learning about many different things
senses.chn: 好学的；好奇的；兴趣广泛的

ex.en: an inquisitive mind
ex.cn: 勤学好问的精神

senses.def: a person who asks a lot of difficult questions, especially in a way that makes you feel threatened
senses.chn: 连续不断地发问的人；（尤指）盘问者

senses.def: an officer of the Inquisition of the Roman Catholic Church
a meeting that is inquorate does not have enough people present for them to make official decisions by voting
wearing very old torn clothes

ex.en: The children were dressed in rags.
ex.cn: 孩子们穿着破衣烂衫。

senses.def: used to say that a situation is different from what has just been said or from what people believe

ex.en: Outwardly she seemed confident but in reality she felt extremely nervous.
ex.cn: 表面上看，她显得信心十足，而实际上她紧张得要命。

senses.def: available to be used in the future or when needed

ex.en: The money was being kept in reserve for their retirement.
ex.cn: 他们把钱存着以备退休后使用。

ex.en: 200 police officers were held in reserve.
ex.cn: 200 名警察随时待命。

senses.def: having an official position in a particular place such as a college or university
senses.chn: （在大学等处）有正式职位，常驻

ex.en: a writer in residence
ex.cn: 常驻作家

senses.def: concerning

ex.en: A writ was served on the firm in respect of their unpaid bill.
ex.cn: 公司由于欠账而收到了传票。

senses.def: in payment for sth

ex.en: money received in respect of overtime worked
ex.cn: 得到的加班费

senses.def: thinking about a past event or situation, often with a different opinion of it from the one you had at the time

ex.en: In retrospect, I think that I was wrong.
ex.cn: 回首往事，我觉得当时我错了。

ex.en: The decision seems extremely odd, in retrospect.
ex.cn: 回想起来，这个决定显得极其荒谬。

senses.def: in the opposite order or way

ex.en: The secret number is my phone number in reverse.
ex.cn: 这个密码是我的电话号码的逆序排列。

ex.en: We did a similar trip to you, but in reverse.
ex.cn: 我们走了和你相似的旅程，但方向相反。

senses.def: something that is achieved, especially by reducing the power or success of sth else
senses.chn: （尤指通过消耗或削弱其他事物取得的）进展

ex.en: This deal is their first major inroad into the American market.
ex.cn: 这交易是他们进军美国市场的首次重大收获。

senses.def: if one thing makes inroads into another, it has a noticeable effect on the second thing, especially by reducing it, or influencing it

ex.en: Tax rises have made some inroads into the country's national debt.
ex.cn: 增加税收已使国债有所减少。

senses.def: if you write or draw sth in rough, you make a first version of it, not worrying too much about mistakes or details
looking or feeling very healthy
destroyed or severely damaged
senses.chn: 毁坏；严重受损；破败不堪

ex.en: Years of fighting have left the area in ruins.
ex.cn: 经年的战事已经使得这个地区满目疮痍。

ex.en: The scandal left his reputation in ruins.
ex.cn: 这件丑闻使他身败名裂。

senses.def: a sudden flow towards the inside

ex.en: an inrush of air/water
ex.cn: 空气／水的涌入

senses.def: being taken care of well by sb
senses.chn: 在可靠的人手里；受到妥善照管

ex.en: I've left the kids in safe hands—with my parents.
ex.cn: 我把孩子托付给了靠得住的人，在我父母那儿。

ex.en: Their problem was in the safe hands of the experts.
ex.cn: 他们的问题交给行家处理了。

senses.def: dirty and with many things that need to be repaired, cleaned or replaced
seriously mentally ill and unable to live in normal society
senses.chn: 精神失常的；精神错乱的

ex.en: Doctors certified him as insane.
ex.cn: 医生证明他精神失常。

ex.en: The prisoners were slowly going insane.
ex.cn: 囚犯正慢慢地变得精神错乱起来。

ex.en: The question is, was the man insane when he committed the crime?
ex.cn: 问题在于这男人犯罪时是否处于精神失常状态？

ex.en: the treatment of anxiety in neurotic patients
ex.cn: 对神经官能症病人焦虑感的治疗

ex.en: She became neurotic about keeping the house clean.
ex.cn: 她对保持房子清洁有点神经质。

ex.en: He works with emotionally disturbed children.
ex.cn: 他从事跟精神异常儿童有关的工作。

senses.def: people who are insane
senses.chn: 精神失常的人；精神错乱的人

ex.en: a hospital for the insane
ex.cn: 精神病院

ex.en: The question is, was the man insane when he committed the crime?
ex.cn: 问题在于这男人犯罪时是否处于精神失常状态？

ex.en: the treatment of anxiety in neurotic patients
ex.cn: 对神经官能症病人焦虑感的治疗

ex.en: She became neurotic about keeping the house clean.
ex.cn: 她对保持房子清洁有点神经质。

ex.en: He works with emotionally disturbed children.
ex.cn: 他从事跟精神异常儿童有关的工作。

senses.def: very stupid, crazy or dangerous
senses.chn: 十分愚蠢的；疯狂的；危险的

ex.en: I must have been insane to agree to the idea.
ex.cn: 我肯定是犯傻了，居然同意了这个想法。

ex.en: This job is driving me insane (= making me feel very angry).
ex.cn: 这份工作快要把我逼疯了。

senses.def: dirty and likely to spread disease
the state of being insane
senses.chn: 精神失常；精神错乱；精神病

ex.en: He was found not guilty, by reason of insanity.
ex.cn: 他因精神失常而获判无罪。

senses.def: actions that are very stupid and possibly dangerous
senses.chn: 十分愚蠢的行为；荒唐的行为

ex.en: It would be sheer insanity to attempt the trip in such bad weather.
ex.cn: 天气这么糟糕还要去旅行，太荒唐了。

senses.def: always wanting more of sth; not able to be satisfied

ex.en: an insatiable appetite/curiosity/thirst
ex.cn: 永不满足的食欲／好奇心／渴望

ex.en: There seems to be an insatiable demand for more powerful computers.
ex.cn: 人们对计算机性能的要求似乎永无止境。

senses.def: in order to help sb

ex.en: We collected money in behalf of the homeless.
ex.cn: 我们为帮助无家可归者而募捐。

senses.def: during the part of sb's life when they were most successful, famous, etc.

ex.en: She was a great dancer in her day.
ex.cn: 她曾是红极一时的舞蹈家。

senses.def: when sb was young

ex.en: In my day, there were plenty of jobs when you left school.
ex.cn: 我年轻时，毕业后就业机会很多。

senses.def: working for sb; employed by sb
senses.chn: 替某人工作；为某人所雇用

senses.def: in sb's opinion or according to the way that they see the situation
senses.chn: 按某人的意见；在某人眼里；依某人看

ex.en: She can do no wrong in her father's eyes.
ex.cn: 在她父亲看来，她不可能做坏事。

senses.def: annoying sb by criticizing them or telling them what to do all the time
senses.chn: 批评某人，支使某人（使人恼火）

senses.def: if sth is in sb's favour, it gives them an advantage or helps them
senses.chn: 有利于某人；有助于某人

ex.en: The exchange rate is in our favour at the moment.
ex.cn: 目前汇率对我们有利。

ex.en: She was willing to bend the rules in Mary's favour.
ex.cn: 她愿意放宽规定以有利于玛丽。

senses.def: a decision or judgement that is in sb's favour benefits that person or says that they were right
senses.chn: （决定）对某人有利；（判决）判某人正确

senses.def: being taken care of or controlled by sb
senses.chn: 受某人照料；受某人控制

ex.en: The matter is now in the hands of my lawyer.
ex.cn: 这件事现在正由我的律师处理。

ex.en: At that time, the castle was in enemy hands.
ex.cn: 那时城堡在敌人手中。

senses.def: being taken care of by sb
senses.chn: 由某人照料（或供养、饲养）

senses.def: with sb in the same place

ex.en: The document was signed in the presence of two witnesses.
ex.cn: 本文件是有两位证人见证签署的。

ex.en: She asked them not to discuss the matter in her presence.
ex.cn: 她要求他们不要当着她的面讨论这个问题。

senses.def: following behind sb

ex.en: In the train of the rich and famous came the journalists.
ex.cn: 记者蜂拥在豪绅名流之后。

senses.def: being taken care of by sb

ex.en: The family pet was left in the trust of a neighbour.
ex.cn: 这家的宠物委托邻居代管。

senses.def: the inner nature of a person or thing as shown in a work of art, especially in a poem
senses.chn: （艺术作品尤其是诗歌中所表现的人或物的）内在特性，本质

senses.def: to write or cut words, your name, etc. onto sth
senses.chn: 在…上写（词语、名字等）；题；刻

ex.en: His name was inscribed on the trophy.
ex.cn: 他的名字刻在奖杯上。

ex.en: The trophy was inscribed with his name.
ex.cn: 奖杯上刻着他的名字。

ex.en: She signed the book and inscribed the words 'with grateful thanks' on it.
ex.cn: 她在书上签了名，并在上面写道 “谨致由衷感谢”。

example.en: His name was inscribed on the trophy.
example.cn: 他的名字刻在奖杯上。

example.en: The trophy was inscribed with his name.
example.cn: 奖杯上刻着他的名字。

senses.def: words written in the front of a book or cut in stone or metal
senses.chn: （书首页的）题词；（石头或金属上）刻写的文字，铭刻，碑文

senses.def: if a person or their expression is inscrutable, it is hard to know what they are thinking or feeling, because they do not show any emotion
senses.chn: 难以捉摸的；难以理解的；神秘莫测的

senses.def: a measurement of the length of the inside of sb's leg, used for making or choosing trousers of the correct size
easily available and ready to eat because it is the right time of year for them
ready to reproduce
without other people knowing about it

ex.en: The meeting was held in secret.
ex.cn: 会议是秘密召开的。

senses.def: any small creature with six legs and a body divided into three parts. Insects usually also have wings. Ants, bees and flies are all insects.

ex.en: insect species
ex.cn: 昆虫种类

ex.en: insect repellent (= a chemical that keeps insects away)
ex.cn: 驱虫剂

ex.en: an insect bite
ex.cn: 昆虫咬伤

senses.def: a chemical used for killing insects
any animal that eats insects
not confident about yourself or your relationships with other people

ex.en: He's very insecure about his appearance.
ex.cn: 他对自己的长相很没信心。

ex.en: She felt nervous and insecure.
ex.cn: 她感到局促不安。

senses.def: not safe or protected
senses.chn: 不安全的；无保障的；不牢靠的

ex.en: Jobs nowadays are much more insecure than they were ten years ago.
ex.cn: 当今的工作比十年前要不安稳得多了。

ex.en: As an artist he was always financially insecure.
ex.cn: 作为一名艺术家，他在经济上总是没有保障。

ex.en: Insecure doors and windows (= for example, without good locks) make life easy for burglars.
ex.cn: 门窗不牢靠方便了窃贼。

senses.def: to put sperm into a woman or female animal in order to make her pregnant

ex.en: The cows are artificially inseminated.
ex.cn: 这些母牛是人工授精的。

senses.def: the state of being unconscious
the fact of not being able to react to a particular thing
senses.chn: （对某事物的）麻木，无反应能力

ex.en: insensibility to pain
ex.cn: 对疼痛无感觉

senses.def: unable to feel sth or react to it
senses.chn: （对某事物）无感觉，无反应能力，麻木

ex.en: insensible to pain/cold
ex.cn: 感觉不到疼痛／冷

senses.def: not aware of a situation or of sth that might happen

ex.en: They were not insensible of the risks.
ex.cn: 他们对这些危险并非没有意识。

senses.def: unconscious as the result of injury, illness, etc.

ex.en: He drank himself insensible.
ex.cn: 他喝酒醉得不省人事。

senses.def: not realizing or caring how other people feel, and therefore likely to hurt or offend them
senses.chn: （对他人的感受）未意识到的，漠不关心的

ex.en: an insensitive remark
ex.cn: 冷漠的言论

ex.en: She's completely insensitive to my feelings.
ex.cn: 她全然不顾我的感情。

senses.def: not aware of changing situations, and therefore of the need to react to them
senses.chn: （对变化）懵然不知的，麻木不仁的

ex.en: The government seems totally insensitive to the mood of the country.
ex.cn: 政府似乎对全国民众的心情完全懵然不知。

senses.def: not able to feel or react to sth

ex.en: insensitive to pain/cold
ex.cn: 感觉不到疼痛／寒冷

ex.en: He seems completely insensitive to criticism.
ex.cn: 他似乎对批评麻木不仁。

example.en: She's completely insensitive to my feelings.
example.cn: 她全然不顾我的感情。

senses.def: not able to be separated
senses.chn: （与某事物）不可分离的，分不开的

ex.en: Our economic fortunes are inseparable from those of Europe.
ex.cn: 我们的经济命运和欧洲的息息相关。

senses.def: if people are inseparable, they spend most of their time together and are very good friends
to put sth into sth else or between two things

ex.en: Insert coins into the slot and press for a ticket.
ex.cn: 把硬币放进投币口，按钮取票。

ex.en: They inserted a tube in his mouth to help him breathe.
ex.cn: 他们在他嘴里插了根导管帮助他呼吸。

senses.def: to add sth to a piece of writing

ex.en: Position the cursor where you want to insert a word.
ex.cn: 把光标移到你想插入字词的地方。

ex.en: Later, he inserted another paragraph into his will.
ex.cn: 后来他在他的遗嘱中又加了一段。

senses.def: an extra section added to a book, newspaper or magazine, especially to advertise sth

ex.en: an 8-page insert on the new car models
ex.cn: 附加的 8 页新型汽车广告

senses.def: something that is put inside sth else, or added to sth else

ex.en: These inserts fit inside any style of shoe.
ex.cn: 这些鞋垫适合任何式样的鞋。

example.en: Position the cursor where you want to insert a word.
example.cn: 把光标移到你想插入字词的地方。

example.en: Later, he inserted another paragraph into his will.
example.cn: 后来他在他的遗嘱中又加了一段。

senses.def: the act of putting sth inside sth else; a thing that is put inside sth else

ex.en: An examination is carried out before the insertion of the tube.
ex.cn: 插入导管前先要进行检查。

senses.def: a thing that is added to a book, piece of writing, etc.; the act of adding sth
senses.chn: （书、文章等中）添加的东西；添加；插入

ex.en: the insertion of an extra paragraph
ex.cn: 插入一个附加段落

senses.def: done while sb is working in a job, in order to learn new skills

ex.en: in-service training
ex.cn: 在职培训

senses.def: a small picture, map, etc. inside a larger one
senses.chn: （套印在大图片、地图等中的）小图，小地图

ex.en: For the Shetland Islands, see inset.
ex.cn: 关于设得兰群岛，见小地图。

senses.def: something that is added on to sth else, or put inside sth else

ex.en: The windows have beautiful stained glass insets.
ex.cn: 窗户上镶着漂亮的彩色玻璃。

senses.def: to fix sth into the surface of sth else, especially as a decoration

ex.en: The tables were inset with ceramic tiles.
ex.cn: 桌子上镶嵌着瓷砖。

ex.en: Ceramic tiles were inset into the tables.
ex.cn: 桌子上镶嵌着瓷砖。

senses.def: to put a small picture, map, etc. inside the borders of a bigger one
senses.chn: （在大图片、地图等中）套印小图

example.en: The tables were inset with ceramic tiles.
example.cn: 桌子上镶嵌着瓷砖。

example.en: Ceramic tiles were inset into the tables.
example.cn: 桌子上镶嵌着瓷砖。

senses.def: extremely happy
senses.chn: 身处七重天；极乐；极为幸福

ex.en: Now that he's been promoted he's in seventh heaven.
ex.cn: 他得到擢升，简直乐上天了。

senses.def: in the sea but close to the shore

ex.en: an inshore breeze
ex.cn: 海岸边的微风

ex.en: an inshore lifeboat (= that stays close to the land)
ex.cn: 近海救生艇

senses.def: in a few words

ex.en: His novels belong to a great but vanished age. They are, in short, old-fashioned.
ex.cn: 他的小说属于一个辉煌但已逝去的时代。一句话，已经过时了。

senses.def: quickly and without trouble
not existing in large enough quantities to satisfy demand

ex.en: Basic foodstuffs were in short supply.
ex.cn: 基本食物紧缺。

ex.en: Sunshine will be in short supply for the west coast.
ex.cn: 西海岸将不会有充足的阳光。

senses.def: very badly damaged

ex.en: Her nerves were in shreds.
ex.cn: 她的神经崩溃了。

ex.en: The country's economy is in shreds.
ex.cn: 国家经济已是百孔千疮。

senses.def: torn in many places

ex.en: The document was in shreds on the floor.
ex.cn: 那份文件在地上，已经破烂不堪。

senses.def: on or to the inner part of sth/sb; within sth/sb

ex.en: Go inside the house.
ex.cn: 进屋里吧。

ex.en: Inside the box was a gold watch.
ex.cn: 盒子里装着一只金表。

ex.en: For years we had little knowledge of what life was like inside China.
ex.cn: 以往很多年我们对于中国国内的生活情况所知甚少。

ex.en: You'll feel better with a good meal inside you.
ex.cn: 你肚子饱了感觉就会好些的。

ex.en: Inside most of us is a small child screaming for attention.
ex.cn: 我们大多数人的内心都藏着一个呼求关注的小孩。

senses.def: in less than the amount of time mentioned

ex.en: The job is unlikely to be finished inside (of) a year
ex.cn: 这项工作不大可能在一年之内完成。

senses.def: on or to the inside

ex.en: She shook it to make sure there was nothing inside.
ex.cn: 她把它晃了晃，以确定里面没有东西。

ex.en: We had to move inside (= indoors) when it started to rain.
ex.cn: 开始下雨了，我们只好躲进屋里。

ex.en: I pretended not to care but I was screaming inside.
ex.cn: 表面上我佯装不在乎，但内心却在高声喊叫。

senses.def: in prison

ex.en: He was sentenced to three years inside.
ex.cn: 他被判三年监禁。

senses.def: the inner part, side or surface of sth

ex.en: The inside of the box was blue.
ex.cn: 盒子的内面呈蓝色。

ex.en: The door was locked from the inside.
ex.cn: 门从里面锁上了。

ex.en: The shell is smooth on the inside.
ex.cn: 贝壳内壁光滑。

ex.en: the insides of the windows
ex.cn: 窗户的内侧

senses.def: the part of a road nearest the edge, that is used by slower vehicles

ex.en: He tried to overtake on the inside.
ex.cn: 他试图从慢车道超车。

senses.def: the part of a curved road or track nearest to the middle or shortest side of the curve
senses.chn: （道路或跑道拐弯处的）内侧，里道，内圈

ex.en: The French runner is coming up fast on the inside.
ex.cn: 法国的赛跑选手正从内圈迅速赶上来。

senses.def: a person's stomach and bowels

ex.en: She was so nervous, her insides were like jelly.
ex.cn: 她紧张得六神无主。

senses.def: with the part that is usually inside facing out

ex.en: You've got your sweater on inside out.
ex.cn: 你把毛线衫里外穿反了。

ex.en: Turn the bag inside out and let it dry.
ex.cn: 把包翻过来晾干。

senses.def: belonging to a group or an organization and therefore able to get information that is not available to other people
senses.chn: 属于某团伙（或组织）的；知情的

ex.en: The thieves must have had someone on the inside helping them.
ex.cn: 这些窃贼肯定有内应。

senses.def: to make a place very untidy when you are searching for sth

ex.en: The burglars had turned the house inside out.
ex.cn: 窃贼把房子翻了个底朝天。

senses.def: to cause large changes

ex.en: The new manager turned the old systems inside out.
ex.cn: 新任经理对旧体制进行了彻底的改革。

senses.def: to be very familiar with sb/sth

ex.en: This is where I grew up. I know this area like the back of my hand.
ex.cn: 我在这儿长大的，我对这地方再熟悉不过了。

senses.def: forming the inner part of sth; not on the outside

ex.en: the inside pages of a newspaper
ex.cn: 报纸的内页

ex.en: an inside pocket
ex.cn: 里袋

ex.en: I was driving in the inside lane (= the part nearest the edge, not the middle of the road).
ex.cn: 我当时驾车在慢车道上行驶。

senses.def: known or done by sb in a group or an organization
senses.chn: 从内部了解到的；内线干的

ex.en: inside information
ex.cn: 内部情报

ex.en: Any newspaper would pay big money to get the inside story on her marriage.
ex.cn: 任何一家报纸都愿出高价购买她婚姻的内幕消息。

ex.en: The robbery appeared to have been an inside job.
ex.cn: 这次抢劫像是内部人干的。

senses.def: a measurement of the length of the inside of sb's leg, used for making or choosing trousers of the correct size
with the part that is usually inside facing out

ex.en: You've got your sweater on inside out.
ex.cn: 你把毛线衫里外穿反了。

ex.en: Turn the bag inside out and let it dry.
ex.cn: 把包翻过来晾干。

senses.def: a person who knows a lot about a group or an organization, because they are part of it

ex.en: The situation was described by one insider as 'absolute chaos'.
ex.cn: 据一名内部人士说，实情是乱作一团。

senses.def: the crime of buying or selling shares in a company with the help of information known only by those connected with the business, before this information is available to everybody
senses.chn: 内线交易，内幕交易（根据内线消息买卖股票的违法行为）

senses.def: a position in which you have an advantage over sb else
spreading gradually or without being noticed, but causing serious harm

ex.en: the insidious effects of polluted water supplies
ex.cn: 供水系统污染的潜在恶果

senses.def: the ability to see and understand the truth about people or situations

ex.en: a writer of great insight
ex.cn: 有深刻洞察力的作家

ex.en: With a flash of insight I realized what the dream meant.
ex.cn: 我突然明白了这个梦意味着什么。

senses.def: an understanding of what sth is like

ex.en: The book gives us fascinating insights into life in Mexico.
ex.cn: 这本书生动地表现了墨西哥的生活。

senses.def: showing a clear understanding of a person or situation
senses.chn: 有深刻了解的；富有洞察力的

senses.def: the symbol, badge or sign that shows sb's rank or that they are a member of a group or an organization
