senses.def: to happen in a way that delays sth or prevents it from happening

ex.en: They were planning to get married and then the war intervened.
ex.cn: 他们正准备结婚，不巧却因爆发战事而受阻。

senses.def: to exist between two events or places

ex.en: I saw nothing of her during the years that intervened.
ex.cn: 这期间的几年中我根本没有见过她。

example.en: The President intervened personally in the crisis.
example.cn: 总统亲自出面处理这场危机。

senses.def: coming or existing between two events, dates, objects, etc.
senses.chn: 发生于其间的；介于中间的

ex.en: Little had changed in the intervening years.
ex.cn: 这些年间没有发生什么变化。

senses.def: action taken to improve or help a situation

ex.en: calls for government intervention to save the steel industry
ex.cn: 呼吁政府出面挽救钢铁业

ex.en: In the second group of states, direct intervention in the economy was limited.
ex.cn: 对于第二组别的国家，对经济的直接干预是有限的。

senses.def: action by a country to become involved in the affairs of another country when they have not been asked to do so
senses.chn: （对他国事务的）介入，干预，干涉行为

ex.en: armed/military intervention
ex.cn: 武装／军事干涉

ex.en: NATO intervention in the troubled region
ex.cn: 北约对这一动荡地区的干预行动

senses.def: action taken to improve a medical condition or illness

ex.en: a medical/surgical intervention
ex.cn: 医疗／手术干预

senses.def: the act of interrupting sb when they are speaking in order to say sth
an occasion when a group of people confront a friend or family member who has an addiction to drugs or alcohol, in order to help them recover
senses.chn: （对有毒瘾或酒瘾的朋友或家人的）帮助戒毒，帮助戒酒

ex.en: Her daughters staged an intervention.
ex.cn: 她的女儿们开始介入，帮助戒除瘾症。

example.en: In the second group of states, direct intervention in the economy was limited.
example.cn: 对于第二组别的国家，对经济的直接干预是有限的。

senses.def: the policy or practice of a government influencing the economy of its own country, or of becoming involved in the affairs of other countries
a formal meeting at which sb is asked questions to see if they are suitable for a particular job, or for a course of study at a college, university, etc.

ex.en: a job interview
ex.cn: 求职面试

ex.en: to be called for (an) interview
ex.cn: 获通知约见

ex.en: He has an interview next week for the manager's job.
ex.cn: 他下周要接受一个经理职位的面试。

senses.def: a meeting (often a public one) at which a journalist asks sb questions in order to find out their opinions

ex.en: a television/radio/newspaper interview
ex.cn: 电视／电台／报纸采访

ex.en: an interview with the new Governor
ex.cn: 对新任州长的采访

ex.en: to give an interview (= to agree to answer questions)
ex.cn: 接受采访

ex.en: Yesterday, in an interview on German television, the minister denied the reports.
ex.cn: 昨天，在德国电视台的采访中，部长否认了那些报道。

ex.en: to conduct an interview (= to ask sb questions in public)
ex.cn: 进行采访

ex.en: The interview was published in all the papers.
ex.cn: 各家报纸都刊载了这次访谈。

senses.def: a private meeting between people when questions are asked and answered

ex.en: an interview with the careers adviser
ex.cn: 和就业顾问的面谈

senses.def: to talk to sb and ask them questions at a formal meeting to find out if they are suitable for a job, course of study, etc.
senses.chn: 对（某人）进行面试（或面谈）

ex.en: Which post are you being interviewed for?
ex.cn: 你参加哪个职位的面试？

ex.en: We interviewed ten people for the job.
ex.cn: 我们为这份工作面试了十人。

senses.def: to talk to sb and answer questions at a formal meeting to get a job, a place on a course of study, etc.

ex.en: The website gives you tips on interviewing for colleges.
ex.cn: 这个网站为你提供大学面试的窍门。

ex.en: If you don't interview well you are unlikely to get the job.
ex.cn: 如果面试时表现不好，你很可能不会得到这份工作。

senses.def: to ask sb questions about their life, opinions, etc., especially on the radio or television or for a newspaper or magazine

ex.en: Next week, I will be interviewing Spielberg about his latest movie.
ex.cn: 下周我将访问斯皮尔伯格，谈论他的最新电影。

ex.en: The Prime Minister declined to be interviewed.
ex.cn: 首相婉拒了采访。

senses.def: to ask sb questions at a private meeting

ex.en: The police are waiting to interview the injured man.
ex.cn: 警察正等待着向受伤的男子问话。

example.en: He has an interview next week for the manager's job.
example.cn: 他下周要接受一个经理职位的面试。

example.en: an interview with the new Governor
example.cn: 对新任州长的采访

example.en: Next week, I will be interviewing Spielberg about his latest movie.
example.cn: 下周我将访问斯皮尔伯格，谈论他的最新电影。

example.en: The Prime Minister declined to be interviewed.
example.cn: 首相婉拒了采访。

senses.def: the person who answers the questions in an interview
senses.chn: 参加面试者；接受采访者

senses.def: the person who asks the questions in an interview
happening or existing between the First and the Second World Wars

ex.en: the interwar years/period
ex.cn: 两次世界大战之间的时期

senses.def: to twist together two or more pieces of thread, wool, etc.

ex.en: The blue fabric was interwoven with red and gold thread.
ex.cn: 蓝布中交织着红色和金色的线。

ex.en: The problems are inextricably interwoven (= very closely connected).
ex.cn: 问题盘根错节。

senses.def: not having made a will (= a legal document that says what is to happen to a person's property when they die)
the courage and determination necessary to do sth difficult or unpleasant (used when you want to avoid using the word guts)
senses.chn: 勇气，决心，毅力（避免说 guts 时用）

ex.en: He did not have the intestinal fortitude to implement the changes.
ex.cn: 他没有胆量实行变革。

senses.def: a long tube in the body between the stomach and the anus. Food passes from the stomach to the small intestine and from there to the large intestine.
for the reason that; because

ex.en: She was fortunate in that she had friends to help her.
ex.cn: 她很幸运，有一些朋友帮助她。

senses.def: if that happens or has happened; if that is the situation
senses.chn: 既然那样；假使那样的话

ex.en: 'I've made up my mind.' 'In that case, there's no point discussing it.'
ex.cn: “我已经拿定主意了。” “ 既然如此，讨论这件事就毫无意义了。”

senses.def: if that happens
senses.chn: 如果是那样的话；如果那种事情发生

ex.en: In that event, we will have to reconsider our offer.
ex.cn: 如果是那样的话，我们就得重新考虑我们的建议。

senses.def: in a general way, without referring to a particular real person, thing or situation
felt by a number of people to exist or to be happening
senses.chn: 在传播中；流行；可感觉到

ex.en: There's romance in the air.
ex.cn: 有种浪漫的气氛。

senses.def: without any clothes on
being or becoming more powerful or popular
senses.chn: （权力、影响等）越来越大；日益受欢迎

senses.def: not being used at the present time and appearing on the screen behind programs that are being used

in the blink of an eye.lemma: in the blink of an eye

senses.def: very quickly; in a short time
in a position in which you have an advantage
wearing no clothes
no longer in danger or thought to be guilty of sth
senses.chn: 不再有危险；不再被认为有罪

ex.en: It seems that the original suspect is in the clear.
ex.cn: 好像原先的嫌疑犯已被认定无罪。

in the cold light of day.lemma: in the cold light of day

senses.def: when you have had time to think calmly about sth; in the morning when things are clearer
senses.chn: 有时间冷静考虑时；在头脑更清醒些的第二天早晨

ex.en: These things always look different in the cold light of day.
ex.cn: 这些事情在冷静地考虑后总会显得不同。

senses.def: when enough time has passed

ex.en: It is possible that in the course of time a cure for cancer will be found.
ex.cn: 治疗癌症的方法终有一天能找到。

senses.def: in the quietest part of the night
senses.chn: 深夜；在夜晚万籁俱寂时

ex.en: I crept out of bed in the dead of night and sneaked downstairs.
ex.cn: 深夜我悄悄地从床上爬起来，蹑手蹑脚地下了楼。

senses.def: in the coldest part of winter
working for sb; employed by sb
senses.chn: 替某人工作；为某人所雇用

senses.def: after a long period of time or series of events

ex.en: He tried various jobs and in the end became an accountant.
ex.cn: 他尝试过各种各样的工作，最后当上了会计。

senses.def: after everything has been considered

ex.en: You can try your best to impress the interviewers but in the end it's often just a question of luck.
ex.cn: 你可以尽最大的努力给主持面试的人留下深刻的印象，不过最终常常要看运气。

senses.def: when the situation actually happened

ex.en: I got very nervous about the exam, but in the event, I needn't have worried; it was really easy.
ex.cn: 我对考试提心吊胆，但其实我本不必担心，这次考试的确很容易。

senses.def: if sth happens

ex.en: In the event of an accident, call this number.
ex.cn: 万一发生事故就拨这个号码。

ex.en: Sheila will inherit everything in the event of his death.
ex.cn: 他一旦故去，所有财产都由希拉继承。

in the event that sth happens.lemma: in the event that sth happens

senses.def: if sth happens

ex.en: In the event of an accident, call this number.
ex.cn: 万一发生事故就拨这个号码。

ex.en: Sheila will inherit everything in the event of his death.
ex.cn: 他一旦故去，所有财产都由希拉继承。

senses.def: to a great degree

ex.en: The journey would be dangerous in the extreme.
ex.cn: 这段旅程将会是极其危险的。

senses.def: despite problems, difficulties, etc.

ex.en: She showed great courage in the face of danger.
ex.cn: 面对危险她表现出了巨大的勇气。

senses.def: as a result of sth

ex.en: He was unable to deny the charges in the face of new evidence.
ex.cn: 面对新的证据，他无法否认这些指控。

senses.def: where things are most exciting and where a lot is happening
senses.chn: 在生活的快车道上；享受丰富多彩的生活

ex.en: He had a good job, plenty of money and he was enjoying life in the fast lane.
ex.cn: 他有份好工作，钱又多，尽情享受着丰富多彩的生活。

senses.def: as the first part of a series of actions

ex.en: In the first instance, notify the police and then contact your insurance company.
ex.cn: 首先是报警，然后与你的保险公司联系。

senses.def: used at the end of a sentence to talk about why sth was done or whether it should have been done or not
senses.chn: （用于句尾，谈论某事为何或是否应该做）究竟，到底，当初

ex.en: I still don't understand why you chose that name in the first place.
ex.cn: 我仍不明白你究竟为什么取了这么个名字。

ex.en: I should never have taken that job in the first place.
ex.cn: 我当初就不该接受那份工作。

senses.def: if you see sb in the flesh, you are in the same place as them and actually see them rather than just seeing a picture of them
being used at the present time and appearing in front of any other programs on the screen
when the time is appropriate, usually after a long period
senses.chn: 在适当时候，时机成熟时（尤指久待之后）

senses.def: experiencing sth unpleasant that cannot be stopped
senses.chn: 处于不快却无法制止的境遇；受制于某事

ex.en: a country in the grip of recession
ex.cn: 陷入衰退的国家

senses.def: being taken care of or controlled by sb
senses.chn: 受某人照料；受某人控制

ex.en: The matter is now in the hands of my lawyer.
ex.cn: 这件事现在正由我的律师处理。

ex.en: At that time, the castle was in enemy hands.
ex.cn: 那时城堡在敌人手中。

senses.def: owing money

ex.en: We start the current fiscal year $30 million in the hole.
ex.cn: 我们今年的财政年度一开始便负着 3 000 万美元的债。

senses.def: because you want sth to happen

ex.en: I called early in the hope of catching her before she went to work.
ex.cn: 我很早就打了个电话，希望在她上班之前找到她。

ex.en: He asked her again in the vain hope that he could persuade her to come (= it was impossible).
ex.cn: 他又问了她一次，徒然指望着能说服她来。

senses.def: during the period of time between two events; until a particular event happens

ex.en: Despite everything that had happened in the interim, they had remained good friends.
ex.cn: 不管在此期间发生了什么，他们还是好朋友。

ex.en: Her new job does not start until May and she will continue in the old job in the interim.
ex.cn: 她的新工作要到五月份才开始，在这期间她将继续原有的工作。

senses.def: having more information about sth than most people
senses.chn: 知情；熟悉内幕；掌握内情

ex.en: Somebody in the know told me he's going to resign.
ex.cn: 有知情者告诉我他要辞职了。

senses.def: asleep

ex.en: Pete and Jo were still in the land of Nod, so I went out for a walk in the morning sunshine.
ex.cn: 皮特和乔仍沉睡未醒，于是我就在晨光中出门散步去了。

in the land of the living.lemma: in the land of the living

senses.def: awake or alive or no longer ill/sick
in easy, comfortable conditions, and enjoying the advantages of being rich

in the lap of the gods.lemma: in the lap of the gods

senses.def: if the result of sth is in the lap of the gods, you do not know what will happen because it depends on luck or things you cannot control
senses.chn: 由神掌管；结果难以预料；非人力所能左右

senses.def: when there are no other possible courses of action

ex.en: In the last resort we can always walk home.
ex.cn: 顶多我们走回家就是了。

senses.def: after considering sth

ex.en: He rewrote the book in the light of further research.
ex.cn: 他根据进一步的研究重写了那部书。

senses.def: while doing a job
senses.chn: 在执行任务时；在履行职责时

ex.en: A policeman was injured in the line of duty yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天有一名警察在执行公务时受伤。

senses.def: concerning a longer period in the future

ex.en: This measure inevitably means higher taxes in the long run.
ex.cn: 从长远来看这项措施的结果免不了要多纳税。

senses.def: part of a group of people that is dealing with sth important; not part of this group
senses.chn: 属（处理要务的）圈内／圈外人士

senses.def: used to say that a statement is true in most cases

ex.en: The service here is, in the main, reliable.
ex.cn: 这里的服务基本上是可靠的。

senses.def: in the process of becoming sth or of being made

ex.en: This model was two years in the making.
ex.cn: 这种型号是用两年时间制成的。

ex.en: These events are history in the making.
ex.cn: 这些事件将载入史册。

senses.def: interested in buying sth

ex.en: I'm not in the market for a new car at the moment.
ex.cn: 我现在还不想买新车。

senses.def: in the period of time between two times or two events

ex.en: My first novel was rejected by six publishers. In the meantime I had written a play.
ex.cn: 我的第一部小说遭到六家出版商的拒绝。其间我又完成了一部戏剧。

senses.def: in the period of time between two times or two events

ex.en: I hope to go to medical school eventually. In the meanwhile, I am going to study chemistry.
ex.cn: 我希望最终能上医学院。这期间我打算学化学。

senses.def: likely to change; in the process of changing
senses.chn: 要起变化；处于变化之中

senses.def: during the morning of the next day; tomorrow morning

ex.en: I'll give you a call in the morning.
ex.cn: 我明天上午给你打电话。

senses.def: between midnight and midday

ex.en: It must have happened at about five o'clock in the morning.
ex.cn: 这件事一定发生在凌晨五点钟左右。

senses.def: similar to sth; a type of sth; in the style of sth

ex.en: His speech was in the nature of an apology.
ex.cn: 他的话也就是道歉。

senses.def: in the way that things usually happen

ex.en: In the nature of things, young people often rebel against their parents.
ex.cn: 年轻人常常会反抗他们的父母，这很自然。

senses.def: approximately; not exactly

ex.en: It cost in the neighbourhood of $500.
ex.cn: 这大约花费了 500 美元。

senses.def: at the very last moment; just in time before sth bad happens
senses.chn: 在最后一刻；紧要关头；恰是时候

in the not too distant future.lemma: in the not too distant future

senses.def: not a long time in the future but fairly soon
not wearing any clothes

ex.en: She refuses to be photographed in the nude.
ex.cn: 她拒绝拍裸体照片。

senses.def: likely to appear or happen soon

ex.en: I hear there are more staff changes in the offing.
ex.cn: 我听说有更多的人事变动在酝酿中。

senses.def: used to say what normally happens in a particular situation

ex.en: In the ordinary way, she's not a nervous person.
ex.cn: 一般而言，她是个不爱紧张的人。

senses.def: in the language in which a book, etc. was first written, before being translated
senses.chn: 用原著的语言；未经翻译

ex.en: I studied Italian so that I would be able to read Dante in the original.
ex.cn: 我学习意大利语以便能读但丁的原著。

senses.def: used to say that a particular statement is supposed to be true but may in fact be wrong

ex.en: In theory, these machines should last for ten years or more.
ex.cn: 从理论上讲，这些机器应能用十年以上。

ex.en: That sounds fine in theory, but have you really thought it through?
ex.cn: 这话听起来很有道理，但是你真正全面考虑过没有？

senses.def: in the form or shape of sb
senses.chn: 以某人的形骸；通过某人体现

ex.en: Help arrived in the person of his mother.
ex.cn: 来帮忙的是他的母亲。

senses.def: in good health
something that is in the pipeline is being discussed, planned or prepared and will happen or exist soon
senses.chn: 在讨论（或规划、准备）中；在酝酿中

senses.def: with sb in the same place

ex.en: The document was signed in the presence of two witnesses.
ex.cn: 本文件是有两位证人见证签署的。

ex.en: She asked them not to discuss the matter in her presence.
ex.cn: 她要求他们不要当着她的面讨论这个问题。

senses.def: when sth exists in a particular place
senses.chn: 存在…的情况下；有…的存在

ex.en: Litmus paper turns red in the presence of an acid.
ex.cn: 石蕊试纸遇到酸就变红。

senses.def: well known to many people through newspapers and television
senses.chn: （通过报纸、电视）让公众熟知的，广为人知的

ex.en: She doesn't want her children growing up in the public eye.
ex.cn: 她不想让子女在众人瞩目中成长。

senses.def: in a way that does not hide the unpleasant aspects of sth

ex.en: He spent a couple of months on the streets to experience life in the raw.
ex.cn: 他花了几个月时间走街串巷，体验真实的生活。

senses.def: with no clothes on
senses.chn: 赤条条；赤身裸体；一丝不挂

senses.def: used when you are giving a number, price, etc. to show that it is not exact
senses.chn: （表示不确切的数字等）大约，差不多

ex.en: He earns somewhere in the region of €50 000.
ex.cn: 他大约赚 5 万欧元。

senses.def: made so that it can be seen from all sides
senses.chn: 圆雕的；可全方位观看的；立体的

ex.en: an opportunity to see Canova's work in the round
ex.cn: 观看卡诺瓦的圆雕艺术作品的机会

senses.def: with the people watching all around a central stage
in a position of authority and control
senses.chn: 担任领导职务；掌权；在位

senses.def: riding a horse

ex.en: Three weeks after the accident he was back in the saddle.
ex.cn: 出事后三个星期，他就又骑上马了。

in the safe hands of sb.lemma: in the safe hands of sb

senses.def: being taken care of well by sb
senses.chn: 在可靠的人手里；受到妥善照管

ex.en: I've left the kids in safe hands—with my parents.
ex.cn: 我把孩子托付给了靠得住的人，在我父母那儿。

ex.en: Their problem was in the safe hands of the experts.
ex.cn: 他们的问题交给行家处理了。

senses.def: immediately after saying sth that suggests the opposite intention or meaning
senses.chn: 但紧接着，但同时（意味着与前一段意图或意思相反）

ex.en: He praised my work and in the same breath told me I would have to leave.
ex.cn: 他称赞了一番我的工作，但紧接着却对我说不得不辞退我。

senses.def: in trouble

ex.en: I'll be in the shit if I don't get this work finished today.
ex.cn: 要是今天不把这活儿做完，那我就惨了。

senses.def: concerning the immediate future

ex.en: In the short run, unemployment may fall.
ex.cn: 从短期来看，失业率可能降低。

senses.def: not making progress as fast as other people, countries, companies, etc.
senses.chn: 在慢车道上；被甩在后面；落后

senses.def: in trouble

ex.en: We're all in the soup now.
ex.cn: 我们这下遇到麻烦了。

senses.def: despite problems, opposition, etc.
senses.chn: 不管，不顾，尽管遇到（困难、反对等）

ex.en: The new policy was adopted in the teeth of fierce criticism.
ex.cn: 新政策尽管受到强烈的批评，但还是被采用了。

senses.def: in the direction that a strong wind is coming from

ex.en: They crossed the bay in the teeth of a howling gale.
ex.cn: 他们顶着呼啸的狂风渡过了海湾。

senses.def: involved in the busiest or most active part of sth
senses.chn: 在…最繁忙的时候；处于…最活跃部分；在密集处

senses.def: being taken care of by sb

ex.en: The family pet was left in the trust of a neighbour.
ex.cn: 这家的宠物委托邻居代管。

in the twinkling of an eye.lemma: in the twinkling of an eye

senses.def: very quickly
at the front or in the leading position

ex.cn: 过漂泊不定的生活

senses.def: a plan of a journey, including the route and the places that you visit
used to say that sth is not acceptable
it will

it'll be all right on the night.lemma: it'll be all right on the night

senses.def: used to say that a performance, an event, etc. will be successful even if the preparations for it have not gone well
senses.chn: （演出、活动等）到时候自会成功的；车到山前必有路

senses.def: used to say that sth is not important

ex.en: It makes no odds to me whether you go or stay.
ex.cn: 你的去留与我无关。

it never rains but it pours.lemma: it never rains but it pours

senses.def: used to say that when one bad thing happens to you, other bad things happen soon after
senses.chn: 不雨则已，一雨倾盆；祸不单行

senses.def: it is
it has
belonging to or connected with a thing, an animal or a baby
senses.chn: （指事物、动物或婴儿）它的，他的，她的

ex.en: Turn the box on its side.
ex.cn: 把箱子侧着立起来。

ex.en: Have you any idea of its value?
ex.cn: 你知道它的价值吗？

ex.en: The dog had hurt its paw.
ex.cn: 狗弄伤了爪子。

ex.en: The baby threw its food on the floor.
ex.cn: 婴儿把食物扔到地板上了。

senses.def: used by sb who is caught doing sth wrong, to say that they admit that they are wrong
senses.chn: （当场被抓获时说）这是罪有应得，抓得有理

senses.def: used as a reply when sb suggests that you should not do sth
senses.chn: （有人建议不应做某事时用于回答）这是个自由的国家

ex.en: It's a free country; I'll say what I like!
ex.cn: 这是个自由的国家，我想说什么就说什么！

senses.def: I cannot understand it
senses.chn: 我全然不懂；我一窍不通

ex.en: She tried to explain how the system works, but it's all Greek to me.
ex.cn: 她竭力想解释系统如何运作，可我怎么也弄不明白。

senses.def: used to say that the reasons for sth are complicated and you would prefer not to give all the details

it's as broad as it's long.lemma: it's as broad as it's long

senses.def: it makes no real difference which of two possible choices you make
used to express your surprise when you meet sb you know in an unexpected place, or when you are talking to sb and find out that you both know the same person
senses.chn: （意外遇见某人或发现对方也认识某人时表示惊讶）世界真小

senses.def: it's raining heavily
senses.chn: 下着倾盆大雨；大雨滂沱

senses.def: used when the animal or thing that does an action is also affected by it
senses.chn: （指施动并受其影响的动物或事物）

ex.en: The cat was washing itself.
ex.cn: 猫在清洁自己。

ex.en: Does the computer turn itself off?
ex.cn: 电脑会自动关机吗？

ex.en: The company has got itself into difficulties.
ex.cn: 公司本身陷入了困境。

ex.en: There's no need for the team to feel proud of itself.
ex.cn: 那支队伍无须自鸣得意。

senses.def: used to emphasize an animal, a thing, etc.

ex.en: The village itself is pretty, but the surrounding countryside is rather dull.
ex.cn: 村子本身很美，但周围的田野相当单调。

senses.def: to be an example of complete patience, etc.
senses.chn: 十分有耐心（或诚实、朴素等）

ex.en: The manager of the hotel was courtesy itself.
ex.cn: 旅馆经理彬彬有礼。

senses.def: automatically; without anyone doing anything

ex.en: The machine will start by itself in a few seconds.
ex.cn: 机器将在几秒钟后自动启动。

senses.def: alone

ex.en: The house stands by itself in an acre of land.
ex.cn: 房子孤零零地坐落在一大片田野间。

senses.def: considered separately from other things; in its true nature

ex.en: In itself, it's not a difficult problem to solve.
ex.cn: 这本身并不是个难解决的问题。

senses.def: not shared with others

ex.en: It doesn't have the market to itself.
ex.cn: 它未能独占市场。

senses.def: used to say that sth that is happening is surprising
senses.chn: （表示所发生的事情令人惊讶）

ex.en: I'm surprised they've invited me to their wedding—it's not as if I know them well.
ex.cn: 我很惊讶他们居然请我参加他们的婚礼，我跟他们似乎并不熟。

senses.def: used to emphasize that sth is easy to do or understand
senses.chn: （强调容易完成或理解）这又不是大脑开刀

ex.en: Look, this isn't brain surgery we're doing here.
ex.cn: 听着，我们在这儿做的事又不像大脑开刀那么难。

it's not over until the fat lady sings.lemma: it's not over until the fat lady sings

senses.def: used for saying that a situation may still change, for example that a contest, election, etc. is not finished yet, and sb still has a chance to win it
senses.chn: 最后才能见输赢；不到最后，结果难料

senses.def: used to emphasize that sth is easy to do or understand

ex.en: Go on, you can do it. It's not exactly rocket science, is it?
ex.cn: 继续干，你能做得到的。这并非难事，对吧？

senses.def: used when several unfortunate or unpleasant things happen on the same day
senses.chn: 祸不单行；特别倒霉的一天

ex.en: My car broke down and then I locked myself out—it's just not my day!
ex.cn: 我的汽车抛锚了，我又把钥匙锁到车里，真是祸不单行！

senses.def: it must be clear to any sensible person who thinks about it
senses.chn: 这是人人都清楚的；这是明摆着的

ex.en: It stands to reason that they'll leave if you don't pay them enough.
ex.cn: 这是明摆着的，你不给他们足够的报酬，他们就走人。

senses.def: used to tell sb that they, and nobody else, will have to deal with the unpleasant results of their own actions

it takes two to do sth.lemma: it takes two to do sth

senses.def: one person cannot be completely responsible for sth
senses.chn: 双方都有责任；一个巴掌拍不响

ex.en: You can't put all the blame on him. It takes two to make a marriage.
ex.cn: 你不能全责怪他，结婚是两个人的事。

senses.def: used to say that two people or groups, and not just one, are responsible for sth that has happened (usually sth bad)
senses.chn: （常指坏事）一个巴掌拍不响，双方都有责任

senses.def: very small
Independent Television (a group of British companies that produce programmes that are paid for by advertising)
senses.chn: 独立电视公司（英国集团，播放节目费用由广告支付）

senses.def: used to say that sth will be expensive

ex.en: There is a deluxe model available, but it'll cost you.
ex.cn: 有豪华型的，但贵得很。

senses.def: used to say that a situation is not acceptable and should be changed or improved
senses.chn: （表示情况不令人满意、需要改变或改进）那不行，这不合适

ex.en: This is the third time you've been late this week; it simply won't do.
ex.cn: 这是你本周第三次迟到了，这可不行啊。

senses.def: the abbreviation for 'intrauterine device' (a small plastic or metal object placed inside a woman's uterus (= where a baby grows before it is born) to stop her becoming pregnant)
senses.chn: 宫内避孕器（全写为 intrauterine device）

senses.def: intravenous, intravenously
I have
used to say that you do not really believe sb's promises or excuses because they are the same ones you have heard before
senses.chn: （表示不相信某人的许诺或辩解）这种话我听得多了

i've only got one pair of hands.lemma: i've only got one pair of hands

senses.def: used to say that you are too busy to do anything else
the abbreviation for 'in vitro fertilization' (a process which fertilizes an egg from a woman outside her body. The egg is then put inside her uterus to develop.)
senses.chn: 体外受精（全写为 in vitro fertilization，使卵子在母体外受精后再放回子宫内发育）

senses.def: (a person) from Côte d'Ivoire/Ivory Coast
senses.chn: 科特迪瓦人；科特迪瓦的；科特迪瓦人的

senses.def: a hard yellowish-white substance like bone that forms the tusks (= long teeth) of elephants and some other animals
senses.chn: 象牙；（某些其他动物的）长牙

ex.en: a ban on the ivory trade
ex.cn: 象牙贸易禁令

ex.en: an ivory chess set
ex.cn: 一副象牙国际象棋

senses.def: an object made of ivory
a yellowish-white colour
a place or situation where you are separated from the problems and practical aspects of normal life and therefore do not have to worry about or understand them
senses.chn: 象牙塔（指远离问题、脱离现实的小天地）

ex.en: academics living in ivory towers
ex.cn: 生活在象牙塔中的学者

senses.def: a climbing plant, especially one with dark green shiny leaves with five points

ex.en: stone walls covered in ivy
ex.cn: 爬满常春藤的石墙

senses.def: a Maori community or people
senses.chn: 毛利部落；毛利部族；毛利人

senses.def: used to say that you do not think that sth is very likely

ex.en: 'She'll soon get used to the idea.' 'I wouldn't bet on it.'
ex.cn: “她很快就会接受这种看法的。” “很难说。”

senses.def: (used especially in text messages, emails, etc., sometimes to suggest indirectly that there is also a hidden meaning in what you have said) if you know what I mean
senses.chn: 如果你懂我的意思（全写为 if you know what I mean，尤用于短信、电邮等）

ex.en: She is creative but not crafty… IYKWIM.
ex.cn: 她有创意，但不精明，如果你懂我的意思。
